item.title: 英、西岸入植地建設のイスラエル企業8社に制裁 「2国家解決」後押し
item.description:
Andrew MacAskill Alexander Cornwell
[ロンドン／テルアビブ １７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andrew MacAskill　Alexander Cornwell

[ロンドン／テルアビブ １７日 ロイター] - 英国は１７日、パレスチナ自治区ヨルダン川西岸で入植地の建設に関与するイスラエル企業８社に制裁を科すと発表した。イスラエルとパレスチナの共存を目指す「２国家解決」を維持する取り組みの一環となる。

英政府は大規模入植地計画「Ｅ１」の入札締め切りを目前に控えて制裁措置を発表。Ｅ１の建設で西岸地区が分断され、東エルサレムとのつながりが断たれることでパレスチナ人が将来の国家の中核と位置付ける土地が分断されると懸念されている。

制裁措置の下で資産凍結などが科されるのは、西岸地区で住宅の建設・開発を手掛ける８社。ミリバンド英外相は声明で「英国の中東政策の根幹は、２国家解決の支持だ」とし、「Ｅ１計画に関する私のメッセージは明確だ。２国家解決の破壊で利益が得られることがあってはならない」と述べた。

イスラエルのサール外相は、英国の制裁措置は「合法的に事業を行う民間企業を標的とした敵対的行為だ」と反発。西岸地区の入植地を強化する新たな方策を検討するとし、対抗措置を講じると表明した。

パレスチナ自治政府は英国の制裁を歓迎。他の国にも同様の措置を講じるよう呼びかけている。

item.title: Anthropic promises to pursue humanity's benefit. Its IPO filing gives it wiggle room
item.description: When Anthropic goes public on Wall Street, the new pressure to deliver profits will test a commitment to prioritize humanity’s benefit as it develops AI.
item.dc:creator: The Associated Press
item.content:encoded: When Anthropic goes public on Wall Street, the new pressure to deliver profits will test a commitment it has made since its founding: to prioritize humanity’s benefit as it develops artificial intelligence. The San Francisco startup, which plans an initial public offering this month, has sketched out a governance structure that it says will protect the company’s broader mission against the pull of financial interests. But the mechanisms it describes give the company wide leeway to decide how to measure whether it’s benefiting society, experts say. Like its rival OpenAI, Anthropic is a public benefit corporation, a legal designation used by companies that pledge to balance shareholder interests with the public good. How that will play out for companies worth potentially trillions of dollars is uncharted territory. “I think then the real test emerges if and when the question of public benefit becomes costly” — or when the public benefit comes into conflict with making a profit, said Sarah Kreps, a professor and director of Cornell University’s Tech Policy Institute. In its regulatory filings, Anthropic pledges to pursue long-term benefits of humanity through the responsible development of advanced AI. “We strive to help bring humanity safely into an era where transformative AI exerts tremendous and potentially decisive influence over a broad range of human undertakings,” the company said. Anthropic also has pledged at least five per cent of its stock to a “public benefit” fund and its founders have committed to donate 80 per cent of their wealth. A pledge to do good is baked into corporate structure Other tech companies have pledged to do good including Google, which prominently featured its then-motto, “Don’t Be Evil,” in its investor prospectus when it went public in 2004. But the words were not legally binding, and critics have accused the tech giant of leaving them behind. Elon Musk’s takeover of Twitter in 2022 shows how the conflict between profit and public good might play out in real life, said Stavros Gadinis, a law professor at UC Berkeley School of Law. “Let’s say that Twitter’s directors felt that Elon was the wrong guy to police the public square because they didn’t trust him, they didn’t like him, they didn’t think he’d be fair, whatever it was,” Gadinis said. “But he made them an offer that was so high compared to what their advisors told them the company was really worth that it would be against their fiduciary duties to not sell to Elon. This is the situation that the public benefit charter is trying to avoid.” Had Twitter been a public benefit corporation, it could have been required to consider factors beyond maximizing shareholder value when selling the company. There aren’t many public benefit corporations whose shares are publicly traded and they are all much smaller than Anthropic and OpenAI. They include the eyewear company Warby Parker, the insurance company Lemonade and software developer Veeva Systems, which had a conventional corporate structure when it went public in 2013 and converted to a public benefit corporation in 2021. Anthropic’s idealistic ambitions for how it develops AI could run up against competitive pressure, such as from China, Kreps said. Anthropic and OpenAI’s models have gone from answering almost any question, even if it was dangerous, to becoming much more circumspect. But as they face more competition, including from open-source Chinese models that likely will tell you whatever you want, she said, “will they start to rethink some of those guardrails? And what happens then?” The setup generally is not preferred by shareholders because it gives more power to the company’s board than it does to shareholders. Whatever a company decides as its public benefit mission, it will likely be much more difficult to measure than profits. That’s particularly true for AI companies, whose leaders have exalted AI as the solution to many of humanity’s problems — from curing cancer to creating economic prosperity. “There are these echo chambers, the Silicon Valley bubble where they really think that what they’re doing is for the good of humanity,” Kreps said. And someone immersed in that environment, she added, might not even ask the right questions or understand how “public benefit” should be measured. A trust aims to hold Anthropic accountable A Long-Term Benefit Trust created by Anthropic is intended to operate as an independent body of trustees with expertise in AI safety, national security, public policy, and social enterprise. Through a special Class T common stock, the trust “generally has the authority to elect and remove” Class T directors, who together will constitute a majority of Anthropic’s board of directors, according to the IPO filing. The Class T common stock is a single share that allows the five trustees to vote as a unit. It has no economic rights — meaning they get to vote but they don’t see any financial benefit or losses from the share and can’t sell it. “The LTBT’s arrangements are designed to minimize the LTBT’s and the Trustees’ exposure to our financial performance and grant the Trustees sufficient independence to ensure we are striking this balance appropriately,” the filing said. Three of the company’s board directors are elected by the trust directly, and another three are elected by other shareholders, which include the company founders with a 50.1 per cent voting majority. A seventh director, with a potentially tie-breaking vote, is nominated by the trust and the holders of the Class T shares, but cannot be appointed or removed without consent from the board’s nominating committee, which is expected to be controlled by the founders. Effectively, the trust can only hold Anthropic accountable on issues such as AI safety and the company’s broader mission up to a point, Gadinis said. The trust “cannot determine the everyday decisions of these directors or the management of the company,” he said. ”If they disagree, they will have to go through the effort of removing directors, and they may not be able to remove a majority.” As a public company, Anthropic also will be required to report finances and generally be more transparent than a privately held one. Many public companies dealing with AI, including Google and Microsoft, regularly update the public on efforts to develop AI responsibly. The incentive for transparency could be as powerful as other mechanisms set up in Anthropic’s corporate structure, Gadinis said. “I do think that by being public, we are going to get a lot more information, because a lot of people are going to be asking questions, and companies will be responding to these questions. Not only because they’re required by security laws, but also because they want to build this kind of trust with the investing community,” he said. --- Barbara Ortutay, The Associated Press

item.title: 高インフレなお課題、労働市場は安定＝米アトランタ連銀暫定総裁
item.description: [１７日 ロイター] - 米アトランタ地区連銀のベナブル暫定総裁は１７日、高過ぎるインフレが依然として経済にとっ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
高インフレなお課題、労働市場は安定＝米アトランタ連銀暫定総裁 4:12 配信

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）ビル。2020年5月1日撮影。REUTERS/Kevin Lamarque（ロイター） [１７日 ロイター] - 米アトランタ地区連銀のベナブル暫定総裁は１７日、高過ぎるインフレが依然として経済にとって課題であるとの認識を示した。

ベナブル氏は同連銀が発表した論説で、インフレ率が２％目標を大きく上回る状況下で、「物価上昇が家計にかけている負担は明白だ」と指摘。一方で、「労働市場は、目立った動きはないものの安定している」とし、「『低採用・低解雇』の動きが続いている」との見方を示した。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：ＡＩ投資に迫られる「総点検」、見えないリスクの把握急務に 焦点：「ＡＩの銀行」エヌビディア、ブームへ資金供給後退なら深刻な事態に 焦点：バイナンス63億ドル被害、ハッカー対策で問われる交換所の内部統制 アングル：「フアン氏の代わりはいない」、ＡＩ業界　最大級の擁護者失うリスク アングル：「永久先物」に揺れる米金融街、新たなリスク警戒　政権が導入推進 11/18(水) 4:12 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: Genesis AI Hits $3.5B Valuation in Robotics Bet
item.description: Genesis AI has raised $500 million at a $3.5 billion valuation as it develops general-purpose robots designed to eventually perform complex tasks with human-level dexterity. CEO and co-founder Zhou Xian discusses plans to scale its robotic AI model, manufacture its first fully US-made robots next year and ramp up production. He also explains why Genesis is taking a full-stack approach spanning AI, hardware and individual robot components. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.description: Anthropic’s IPO is highlighting just how much value can be created before public investors ever get a chance to buy in. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Nvidia Faces First Earnings Test Since Huang’s Exit
item.description: Nvidia reports earnings for the first time since Jensen Huang’s surprise departure, putting the chipmaker’s 70% growth outlook and the broader AI trade back in focus. JPMorgan Asset Management’s Stephanie Aliaga discusses why strong compute demand remains intact despite leadership uncertainty, what investors need to hear from Nvidia on growth and China, and how Anthropic’s IPO could give public-market investors a new window into the economics of frontier AI. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Apple services hit by outage
item.description: Various Apple services were hit with outages on Tuesday, according to Apple’s system status site. Affected services include the App Store, Apple Music, and AppleCare on Device.
item.dc:creator: Kayla Thompson
item.content:encoded: Various Apple services were hit with outages on Tuesday, according to Apple’s system status site. The App Store and Apple Music were down briefly on Tuesday afternoon, but are now back online, according to the company. Outages remain on Schoolwork, Apple School Manager, and AppleCare on Device. An “issue” was identified on iCloud Account & Sign in. More details to come...

FAST

Nov 17 : Russian figure skaters have been forced out of this week's Finlandia Trophy after Finland moved to block athletes holding Russian passports from entering the country, dealing a blow to their hopes of reaching the Grand Prix Final. The Russian Figure Skating Federation said on Tuesday that seven athletes, including Olympic pairs medallists Anastasia Mishina and Aleksandr Galliamov, would miss the Helsinki event because they could not travel to Finland. As of Monday, Russian citizens with Schengen visas are only allowed into Finland to work in tasks that are deemed essential to the country's national interests, the government said in a statement. That excludes sport, it said. The Russian federation said it had sought clarification from the International Skating Union (ISU) and Finnish authorities after receiving reports that Russian athletes could face entry restrictions, but did not receive an official response until Tuesday evening.

According to the federation, the ISU informed it that Finnish authorities had concluded Russian athletes, including those competing as neutrals, did not meet the country's entry requirements following tightened restrictions on Russian citizens. The federation quoted the ISU as saying the rules also applied to athletes travelling on Schengen visas for the competition. 'EXTREMELY DISAPPOINTED' With the event due to begin on Friday, the ISU told the federation it had no choice but to assume the Russian skaters would be unable to compete and would instead invite reserve participants. "The Russian Figure Skating Federation is extremely disappointed by Finland's politicized decision regarding our athletes and will continue to work with the ISU to ensure Russian figure skaters' participation in all possible competitions," the Russian federation said in a statement. "The Russian Figure Skating Federation regrets that the athletes have fallen victim to ill-considered and unlawful political decisions and believes that such actions are contrary to the Olympic Charter and the ISU Constitution." Reuters has contacted the Finnish government for comment. Finland's Foreign Minister Elina Valtonen said last week that allowing Russian athletes to enter the country would "endanger Finland's international relations". "As Russia's war of aggression continues, Russian athletes have no business coming to Finland," she said. The Finlandia Trophy is a key qualifier for the Grand Prix Final, the first major best-on-best event of the figure skating season. Also affected are former European champions Aleksandra Boikova and Dmitrii Kozlovskii, pair skaters Ekaterina Chikmareva and Matvei Ianchenkov, and men's singles skater Evgeni Semenenko. The skaters were due to compete as neutral athletes without Russian national symbols under ISU eligibility rules introduced after Russia's invasion of Ukraine. Reuters has contacted the ISU for comment. Last week the ISU said that Finland's restrictions could have a "consequential impact" on its hosting of the World Figure Skating Championships in March, where Russian skaters are expected to be among the medal contenders. RUSSIAN RESTRICTIONS WIDEN Finland's move comes amid other restrictions on Russian participation in sport. Finland banned Russian athletes from this month's cross-country skiing World Cup opener in Ruka, the government announced last week. Norway imposed an immediate entry ban on Russian and Belarusian professional athletes travelling to compete, including those with neutral status, the government announced on Monday. Poland will not issue visas to Russian ski jumpers for its World Cup meetings this season, even if they were cleared to compete as neutrals. Russia will also miss ice hockey's 2027 World Junior Championship because of entry restrictions imposed by the Canadian government, the International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) confirmed on Sunday. The IIHF said it had considered alternative arrangements but decided Canada would remain as host, with the tournament proceeding from December 26 to January 5 in Edmonton and Red Deer.

Source: Reuters

item.title: “Así es la vida”: Trump resta importancia a las interrupciones de servicio de JPMorgan y Microsoft
item.description: Al preguntársele si existía preocupación alguna con respecto al feriado de Acción de Gracias de la próxima semana, uno de los períodos de mayor afluencia de viajeros en Estados Unidos, el presidente r ...
item.dc:creator: Courtney Subramanian, Annmarie Hordern
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — El presidente Donald Trump restó importancia a las preocupaciones sobre una serie de fallos en los principales sistemas estadounidenses en los últimos días, asegurando que los estadounidenses siguen a salvo. “Así es la vida”, dijo Trump en respuesta a preguntas durante un evento el martes por la noche en Manila, Filipinas, donde dio inicio a una visita de tres días a Asia. “Cuando uno es grande y poderoso, y tiene todo el dinero, pasan estas cosas. No pasa nada”. Ver más: JPMorgan restablece sus transacciones tras fallo técnico que retrasó operaciones de clientes La semana pasada comenzaron las interrupciones generalizadas debido a un fallo que paralizó el software de productividad de Microsoft Corp. ( MSFT ). El viernes, Estados Unidos sufrió la suspensión de vuelos durante más de cuatro horas tras un fallo en los equipos que afectó a las instalaciones de control de tráfico aéreo de la Administración Federal de Aviación. Según el secretario de Transporte, Sean Duffy, esto le costó a la economía miles de millones de dólares. El lunes, JPMorgan Chase & Co. ( JPM ), el banco más grande de Estados Unidos, sufrió un " problema técnico " que también afectó a otras instituciones financieras. Ver más: Microsoft revela por qué una falla oculta desde julio paralizó Outlook, Teams y Copilot la semana pasada Trump dijo que había hablado con los bancos, pero no quedó claro a cuáles se refería. “Todo estará bajo control”, afirmó. Al preguntársele si existía preocupación alguna con respecto al feriado de Acción de Gracias de la próxima semana, uno de los períodos de mayor afluencia de viajeros en Estados Unidos, el presidente respondió: “No, en absoluto. La gente está segura”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: 米システム障害、原因は設備老朽化 サイバー攻撃でない＝国土安保長官
item.description:
David Shepardson
[ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - 米国土安全保障省（ＤＨＳ）のマークウェイン・マリン長官は１７日、
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
David Shepardson

[ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - 米国土安全保障省（ＤＨＳ）のマークウェイン・マリン長官は１７日、 米国でこのところ相次いでいるシステム障害について、原因はコンピューターシステムの老朽化で、サイバー攻撃ではないとの見方を示した。

米国ではこのところ連邦航空局（ＦＡＡ）、ユナイテッド航空、マイクロソフト、ＪＰモルガン・チェースなどでシステム障害が発生し、懸念が広がっている。

マリン長官はＣＮＢＣに対し「非常に古いコンピューターシステムに新しい技術を導入していることで、システムに過度の負荷がかかっている」とし、「新技術の導入が進むにつれてこうした事例が増える恐れがある」と指摘。「９８％の確率でサイバー攻撃ではないと言える」と述べた。

item.title: ¿Qué es una bomba sucia? EE.UU. investiga posibles planes de Irán para atacar a funcionarios de Trump
item.description: El artefacto combina explosivos convencionales con material radiactivo y puede contaminar amplias zonas. Washington evalúa la amenaza, aunque no detectó un ataque inminente.
item.dc:creator: Redacción Bloomberg Línea
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg Línea — Estados Unidos detectó indicios de que Irán evalúa posibles ataques con una bomba sucia o un arma química en Washington contra funcionarios de alto rango de la administración de Donald Trump. La información, revelada por el medio de comunicación CNN a partir de consultas con siete funcionarios estadounidenses, incluye posibles blancos y ubicaciones, aunque no existen indicios de que Teherán haya decidido ejecutar un operativo. La Casa Blanca aseguró que monitorea las amenazas potenciales. Sin embargo, afirmó que por el momento no existen amenazas creíbles contra el territorio estadounidense. El presidente Donald Trump indicó que las autoridades estadounidenses están investigando si Irán tiene algún plan para atacar Washington, D.C. “Si es así, pagarán un precio como ningún país ha pagado jamás”, afirmó Trump el martes por la tarde en Manila cuando se le preguntó por la información de la CNN. VER MÁS: Trump dice que EE.UU. investiga un posible plan de Irán para atacar a funcionarios en Washington D.C. Una bomba sucia es un artefacto que combina material radiactivo con explosivos convencionales para dispersar radiación en el área de una detonación. A diferencia de una bomba nuclear, no utiliza una reacción de fisión y su capacidad destructiva es considerablemente menor. Aunque no produce una explosión nuclear, puede dispersar material radiactivo a lo largo de varias cuadras o incluso kilómetros. Según los especialistas citados por CNN, las víctimas probablemente se producirían principalmente por la explosión y no por la radiación. Este tipo de dispositivo es considerado un arma de terror: además de los daños inmediatos, puede provocar contaminación, enfermedades y obligar a evacuar zonas afectadas. Su fabricación también es relativamente sencilla en comparación con la de un arma nuclear. Según la información publicada por CNN, la inteligencia estadounidense detectó comunicaciones en las que se afirma que Irán habría almacenado materiales para fabricar explosivos dentro de Estados Unidos. Sin embargo, los funcionarios consultados están divididos sobre la credibilidad de esos datos. VER MÁS: Irán amenaza con tomar represalias contra objetivos civiles si EE.UU. hace lo mismo Las fuentes señalaron que Teherán estaría explorando alternativas para futuros ataques, pero aclararon que no hay evidencia de una decisión de avanzar con el plan. La información motivó reuniones de contingencia dentro del Gobierno estadounidense. Una de las hipótesis que evalúan las autoridades es que Irán no necesitaría enviar operativos al país, sino que podría recurrir a personas que ya residen en territorio estadounidense. VER MÁS : Economía de la zona euro resiste la guerra en Irán y abre la puerta a más alzas de tasas Las advertencias se producen en medio de la escalada del conflicto entre ambos países, los ataques militares estadounidenses contra Irán y el bloqueo económico que enfrenta Teherán.

Nov 17 : Microsoft on Tuesday announced a suite of AI models with powerful coding and cybersecurity capabilities as it races to challenge rivals such as Anthropic and OpenAI. At the Microsoft Ignite conference in San Francisco, the company unveiled a computer programming model called MAI Code 2, which it says almost matches the performance of rival AI models at a fraction of the cost. The company also touted a cyber-specific model that it plans to offer to a limited group of customers to help address a surge in software vulnerabilities that AI tools are increasingly bringing to light. The company released new image-generation and transcription AI models as well.

Microsoft AI chief Mustafa Suleyman in an interview with Reuters said the company's strategy of building technology specific to different domains was helping it keep costs low while matching rivals and in some cases topping model benchmarks. "This isn't just one model. It's not a flash in the pan," he said. "This is a system, a hill-climbing machine that we have built, which co-optimizes performance and price." Suleyman said the recent cybersecurity reckoning, illustrated by OpenAI agents' hacking of the Hugging Face platform had led him to focus not just on performance but on critical safeguards as well. Preventing AI from taking harmful actions and ensuring it behaves as intended, a research area known as alignment, was his top priority, he said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Sheinbaum habla del T-MEC con Carney y espera reunión con Trump
item.description: Sheinbaum también confirmó que el miércoles sostendrá una “breve reunión” con Donald Trump. El encuentro ocurre en medio de tensiones por temas de migración y seguridad. En días pasados, Trump amagó ...
item.dc:creator: Italia López
item.content:encoded: Ciudad de México — La presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum tiene en la cumbre de líderes del Foro de Cooperación Económica Asia-Pacífico (APEC) un punto de encuentro con sus dos socios en el T-MEC. La mandataria mexicana sostuvo una reunión este martes con el primer ministro de Canadá, Mark Carney, en el marco del encuentro de líderes que se lleva a cabo en Shenzhen, China. “El primer ministro Carney y la presidenta Sheinbaum reafirmaron su compromiso de renovar el Acuerdo Canadá-Estados Unidos-México”, indicó la oficina de Carney en un comunicado. Ver más: Sheinbaum ofrece una “nueva era” en la relación México-China tras tensiones por aranceles También abordaron los avances de un plan de colaboración estratégica bilateral que se anunció en la visita de Carney a México en septiembre de 2025. “Muchas cosas se han cumplido y muchas otras se están cumpliendo, ha aumentado el comercio México-Canadá, han aumentado las inversiones de Canadá en México y de México en Canadá”, dijo Sheinbaum en un enlace desde China durante su conferencia de prensa diaria. Carney y Sheinbaum acordaron acelerar la implementación y ampliar el alcance del plan. Canadá y México han reiterado sus intenciones de renovar el T-MEC, pero Estados Unidos, que ha impuesto aranceles a ambos países, se rehúsa a mantener el acuerdo comercial en su forma actual, dando paso a revisiones anuales. El Gobierno mexicano ha privilegiado el diálogo con Washington y continúa negociando con Estados Unidos para quitar gravámenes y reducir la incertidumbre; mientras Canadá ha optado por imponer aranceles recíprocos y buscar alternativas para reducir su dependencia de Washington. Sheinbaum también confirmó que el miércoles sostendrá una “breve reunión” con Donald Trump. El encuentro ocurre en medio de tensiones por temas de migración y seguridad. En días pasados, Trump amagó con duplicar los aranceles a México si el Gobierno de Sheinbaum no impedía el avance de caravanas migrantes hacia su país. En tanto, el titular de la Administración para el Control de Drogas (DEA, por su sigla en inglés), Terry Cole, dijo este martes en su cuenta de X que seguirán exponiendo los vínculos “entre las organizaciones terroristas extranjeras letales y los actores políticos corruptos para proteger las vidas de los estadounidenses”.

item.title: Higher jet fuel costs force Transat to explore options
item.description: Transat A.T. Inc. has hired financial advisers to help it evaluate potential financing and other opportunities as it deals with the impact of higher jet fuel prices.
item.dc:creator: The Canadian Press
item.content:encoded: Firing off a warning signal about its cash flow, Transat A.T. Inc. has brought financial advisers on board as it struggles to staunch the losses caused by soaring jet fuel prices. The energy crisis triggered in February by war in the Middle East has meant Air Transat spends far more on fuel than it can recoup in ticket sales, given the leisure airline’s price-sensitive customers as well as its competition. The pricier jet kerosene added some $105 million in expenses in the three months ended Oct. 31 versus the same period a year earlier. That brings fuel costs from the war to nearly $280 million so far this year, a toll that amounts to nearly half of Transat’s fuel expense for all of last year. In a news release, the company called the oil crisis a “supply shock without historical precedent” and suggested it would leave a major dent in its earnings for the current quarter and the full fiscal year. “The corporation continues to manage its day-to-day business rigorously. However, its ability to pass higher fuel costs on to customers has remained so far limited which puts ongoing pressure on its financial position,” Transat said. “In this context, it has retained financial advisers to assist in evaluating all potential financing and other corporate opportunities and is seeking proposals in respect thereof.” The situation has already pushed Transat to seek emergency funding from Ottawa. The company secured $250 million in federal aid from the Canada Enterprise Emergency Funding Corp. in September. The low-interest line of credit came on top of a $150-million government loan in July. CEO Annick Guérard said earlier this fall that intense competition curtailed Transat’s ability to shift the swelling cost of fuel onto passengers’ shoulders. “There were big (capacity) increases on the Atlantic market,” she told analysts on a conference call in September. “When we introduced fuel surcharges, the demand went down. The whole Canadian market — competitors, everybody — started to launch promotions. And it never ended.” Those deals and discounts prevented Transat from raising ticket prices and forced it to tamp down some fees. “We’ve never seen such a highly competitive network,” Guérard said at the time. Observers say Transat should not be written off just yet, particularly in the light of Ottawa’s recent approach to foundering corporate ships in the sector. “We would caution against assuming that Transat’s financial challenges will necessarily translate into a meaningful reduction in competition, given the Canadian government’s historical willingness to support smaller airlines,” said analyst Savanthi Syth of Raymond James. She suggested a scale-down was more likely than a shutdown. “Ultimately, we view further Transat capacity rationalization — not an acquisition or exit — as the more plausible source of upside for Air Canada, although the magnitude and timing remain uncertain,” she said in a note to investors. As for the possibility of a merger, “history suggests significant hurdles,” Syth added. Air Canada had been on track to buy the company after reaching a deal in 2019, but COVID-19 and then European red tape tripped up that plan. An earlier $720-million purchase price was watered down to $190 million in October 2020 as the pandemic devastated the airline industry. The federal government greenlit the transaction in early 2021, but the European Commission raised competition concerns over transatlantic routes, prompting the parties to call off the agreement. -- This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 17, 2026.

Operating income in business that include the Disney+ and Hulu streaming services doubled to $824 million in the fiscal fourth quarter, due to higher subscription and ad revenue. Viewership of Marvel superhero-related programming more than doubled as fans caught up on the company’s catalog of Spider-Man and Avengers films, tied in part to theatrical releases from both this year, Disney said in a statement Tuesday. Geetha Ranganathan, Bloomberg Intelligence US Media Analyst said Disney earnings mean show a strong outlook for 2027. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.description: [ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のクック理事は、自身の解任の是非に関するホワイトハウス...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
クックＦＲＢ理事、解任巡るホワイトハウス聴聞会欠席も＝弁護士 2:53 配信

クックＦＲＢ理事。11月16日、サンフランシスコで撮影。REUTERS/Ann Saphir（ロイター） [ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のクック理事は、自身の解任の是非に関するホワイトハウスでの聴聞会に出席しない可能性があると、同氏の弁護士が１７日述べた。

ホワイトハウスは１２月１４日、トランプ大統領がクック理事の解任手続きを進める根拠があるかどうかを判断する聴聞会を開催する予定で、クック氏に出席を求めている。

ロイターが確認した書簡によると、クック氏の弁護士は「クック理事は不公正な聴聞会に参加する法的義務を負っていない。むしろ、ＦＲＢの独自の地位と独立性を損なうような手続きへの参加を拒否することは、ＦＲＢに対する義務だ」と述べた。

トランプ大統領は昨年、住宅ローン不正疑惑を巡り、クック氏を解任。クック氏は解任に法的根拠はないとして提訴し、法廷闘争にもつれ込んでいた。

連邦最高裁は６月、理事の即時解任を認めない判断を示した上で、クック氏に弁明の機会を与えることを条件に、正当な理由があれば解任できるとの判決を下した。ホワイトハウスの国家経済会議（NEC）のハセット委員長は聴聞会について、その判断にそって設けられたものだと説明している。

item.title: China’s export engine faces a reality check as domestic demand falters: Can overseas markets sustain its growth?
item.description: China's export-led growth model faces mounting pressure as weak domestic consumption, slowing factory output and a prolonged property crisis expose vulnerabilities. While AI-driven exports support growth, October data highlight the widening gap between manufacturing strength and household spending.
item.dc:creator: Bhanu Pratap
item.content:encoded: China's export-led growth model is facing a reality check as weak domestic consumption, slowing industrial production and a prolonged property crisis expose vulnerabilities in the world's second-largest economy. While strong overseas demand for artificial intelligence (AI)-related products has helped sustain growth, October's economic data highlight the widening gap between China's manufacturing strength and its struggling domestic economy. The country's industrial output grew 4.8% year-on-year in October, down from 5.5% in September and below the 5.3% forecast by economists polled by Reuters. Retail sales rose just 0.4%, compared with 1.1% in September and against expectations of 0.8%. The figures raise a crucial question for Beijing: can overseas markets continue to support growth while household spending and domestic investment remain subdued? AI exports cushion China's economic slowdown Strong global demand for AI infrastructure, semiconductors and other high-tech products has emerged as an important growth driver for China. Overseas demand for technology products and automobiles helped the economy recover from a second-quarter slowdown, with gross domestic product expanding 4.5% year-on-year in the third quarter, Reuters reported. China's October exports also remained strong, supported by the global AI infrastructure investment boom. However, the resilience of external trade contrasts with weakening domestic indicators, exposing an increasingly uneven recovery. The imbalance could deepen as high-tech manufacturing accounts for a growing share of industrial growth, while traditional industries and consumer-facing sectors struggle with weak demand. China's official data showed that high-end and intelligent manufacturing contributed more than half of industrial output growth in the first 10 months of 2026.This suggests that the export boom is helping sustain economic activity without necessarily generating a broad-based recovery in domestic demand.Weak consumption and property crisis weigh on recoveryDomestic demand remains a major concern for Chinese policymakers. A sluggish labour market, uncertainty over future incomes and falling property prices have weakened consumer confidence, limiting household spending despite major shopping events such as the National Day holiday and Singles Day festival.Services retail sales grew 4.9% in the first 10 months of 2026, marginally slower than the 5% recorded in the first nine months, according to China's National Bureau of Statistics (NBS)."The persistently soft consumer confidence remains the main issue preventing a consumption recovery, and a more effective policy push must address this," Lynn Song, ING's chief economist for Greater China, told Reuters.The property downturn is adding to the pressure. Property investment fell 21.6% year-on-year in January-October, while new home prices declined further in October. Fixed-asset investment also contracted 8.1% during the first 10 months, worsening from a 7.2% decline in January-September, as per the report.The figures suggest that efforts to revive investment through infrastructure spending and cheaper credit have yet to deliver a meaningful recovery.Can exports sustain China's growth?China's dependence on overseas demand also leaves its economy exposed to trade restrictions, geopolitical tensions and any slowdown in global technology investment.An official factory activity survey showed that manufacturers reported weaker conditions in new orders and new export orders in October compared with September. This raises questions about whether the export momentum can be sustained even as domestic demand remains weak.Strong exports could also reduce the immediate pressure on Beijing to introduce deeper measures to revive consumption. However, relying on overseas markets cannot indefinitely compensate for weak household spending and investment.Despite calls for additional support, economists do not expect major stimulus measures before the end of 2026.

item.title: フアン氏の娘、メガスピード巡るエヌビディア対応を主導＝報道
item.description: [１７日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディア のジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の娘、マディソン・フ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
フアン氏の娘、メガスピード巡るエヌビディア対応を主導＝報道 2:10 配信

エヌビディア のジェンスン・フアン前ＣＥＯの娘、マディソン・フアン氏（中央）。8月19日、北京で撮影。REUTERS/Maxim Shemetov（ロイター） [１７日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディア のジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の娘、マディソン・フアン氏が、シンガポール拠点のクラウドコンピューティング企業メガスピードを巡る批判への対応を主導していたと、英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）が１７日、関係者３人の話として報じた。

メガスピードを巡っては、同社幹部だったアリス・フアン氏とフアン前ＣＥＯとの不倫関係が取り沙汰されているほか、アリス氏には中国のスパイだった疑いも浮上している。

報道によると、エヌビディアでプロダクト・技術マーケティング担当シニアディレクターを務めるマディソン氏は、本来の職務範囲を超える責任を担い、エヌビディアとメガスピードの関係に関する対外的な釈明の策定に深く関与したという。

また、エヌビディアとメガスピードの関係が初めて注目を集めたのは、マディソン氏の夫であるニコ・カプレズ氏がエヌビディア幹部へ昇格した昨年終盤のことだったという。

フアン氏が家族を要職に登用していたことは、先週の辞任以前から社内ガバナンスを巡る懸念を招いていたとされる。

ロイターはＦＴの報道を独自に確認していない。

item.description: Nov 17 : South Africa coach Rassie Erasmus has been suspended for six matches following comments he made about the match officials in last week’s 21-19 loss to France, World Rugby said on Tuesday.Erasmus said there had been potential "manipulation of the game" and that officials had missed 17 knee-drop tac

item.content:encoded:

Springbok coach Erasmus suspended for six matches over TMO criticism

FILE PHOTO: Rugby Union - New Zealand tour of South Africa - South Africa v New Zealand - Cape Town Stadium, Cape Town, South Africa - August 29, 2026 South Africa head coach Rassie Erasmus on the pitch before the match REUTERS/Esa Alexander/File Photo

FAST

Nov 17 : South Africa coach Rassie Erasmus has been suspended for six matches following comments he made about the match officials in last week’s 21-19 loss to France, World Rugby said on Tuesday. Erasmus said there had been potential "manipulation of the game" and that officials had missed 17 knee-drop tackles by the French in the Nations Championship fixture. "The TMO (television match official) doesn’t come in once. I’m not saying he’s wrong. I’m saying if he didn’t see it, it must be a technology problem," Erasmus told reporters in Dublin. "If he saw it and he decided not to act on it, is that not match-fixing? Is that not interfering with the outcome of a game?"

Erasmus also suggested his side were treated differently when it came to disciplinary matters compared to the Northern Hemisphere teams. South African governing body SA Rugby have confirmed Erasmus will request a full misconduct hearing in order to "contextualize his comments and assure the panel that it was not his intention to allege that any match official had acted with ulterior motives". "SA Rugby trust that such a hearing could be expedited considering the seriousness of the charge," the organisation said in a statement. Subject to the outcome of an appeal, he will miss Saturday’s fixture against Ireland and the Nations Championship finals weekend, as well as the Springboks’ first four games of 2027. The suspension applies to any match-day involvement including coaching, entering the stadium or coaches’ box, communicating with match officials or engaging in media duties. "Robust, respectful debate is natural, but teams have access to well-established and supported channels and protocols for raising officiating matters before and after matches," World Rugby said in a statement. "Challenging a decision is not the same as questioning an official’s integrity or making comments that expose them to personal abuse." Erasmus was given a two-month ban from all rugby involvement and a 10-and-a-half month suspension from involvement with the Springboks on matchdays after criticising Australian referee Nic Berry during the 2021 British & Irish Lions tour of South Africa.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米国債市場介入の指針整備必要、市場混乱時に備え＝クリーブランド連銀総裁
item.description: [１７日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は１７日、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は市場の混乱が実体経...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国債市場介入の指針整備必要、市場混乱時に備え＝クリーブランド連銀総裁 1:57 配信

２０２５年４月撮影　REUTERS/Mike Segar（ロイター） [１７日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は１７日、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は市場の混乱が実体経済に波及する恐れがある局面に備え、米国債市場への一時的かつ限定的な介入に関する原則を策定しておく必要があるとの考えを示した。

ハマック氏はワシントンのブルッキングス研究所での講演原稿で、２０２０年３月の新型コロナウイルス禍初期と、トランプ大統領による大規模な関税制度の発表後に市場が混乱した２５年４月の２件の事例を教訓として、市場混乱を防ぐことを目指すべきだと指摘。「市場にストレスが発生した場合、どのような原則に基づいて行動し、それをどのように説明するかを判断する時間はほとんどない可能性がある」とし、「建物が煙で満たされ始めてから避難計画を立てるよりも、建物に入った時点で非常口を確認しておく方が望ましい」と述べた。

その上で、ＦＲＢはどのような場合に市場介入を行い、どのような場合には行わないのかについて、明確な理解を持つ必要があると語った。

経済見通しや金融政策見通しに関する言及はなかった。

Nov 17 : Former England midfielder Peter Storey has died aged 81, his former club Arsenal said on Tuesday. • A key member of the Arsenal team who won the First Division title and FA Cup double in 1970-71, Storey made 501 appearances for the club as a tough-tackling central midfielder. • He played 19 times for England between 1971 and 1973. • Storey was convicted of several criminal offences after the end of his football career. • Arsenal will pay their respects to Storey at the Champions League home game against Borussia Dortmund on November 24.

item.title: Russia opens regulated Bitcoin, Ether and USDT access to retail investors
item.description: Russia's central bank has authorized regulated retail access to Bitcoin, Ether and Tether's USDT for non-qualified investors, effective November 17, 2026.The rollout splits the investing public into ...
item.content:encoded:
News / Crypto Briefing / Russia opens regulated Bitcoin, Ether and USDT access to retail investors

Russia opens regulated Bitcoin, Ether and USDT access to retail investors 2 min read

BTCUSD ETHUSD USDTUSD Russia's central bank has authorized regulated retail access to Bitcoin, Ether and Tether's USDT for non-qualified investors, effective November 17, 2026. The rollout splits the investing public into two groups. Qualified investors, the category reserved for more experienced or better-capitalized participants, face no purchase limits and get broader access to crypto trading. Non-qualified investors, meaning most everyday retail buyers, are capped. They can purchase up to 300,000 rubles, approximately $3,600 to $3,700, per year through each licensed intermediary. Everyone has to clear two hurdles before placing a trade. Knowledge tests and risk disclosures are mandatory for all investors, qualified or not. Access also runs through a single type of channel. Transactions can only be conducted via licensed intermediaries such as brokers or registered exchange offices. The launch is staggered across venues. Other exchanges are slated to begin on November 22, while the Moscow Exchange is aiming for a pilot launch of trading by December 1, 2026. The authorization flows from Federal Law No. 282-FZ, which President Vladimir Putin signed on August 4, 2026. That law was designed to formalize the role of digital currencies and digital rights within the Russian economy. One line, however, remains firmly drawn. Paying for goods and services with crypto is still prohibited inside Russia. The research behind this rollout points to an expectation that trading volumes and retail participation could rise as a result. At 300,000 rubles per year per intermediary, individual retail flows are small. The inclusion of USDT stands out. A dollar-pegged stablecoin sitting alongside Bitcoin and Ether on an approved list gives Russian retail investors a regulated way to hold a dollar-linked digital asset. The per-intermediary wording of the cap is a detail worth tracking. How the limit applies in practice when investors use more than one licensed broker will shape how restrictive the rules really feel. Then there is the December 1 target for the Moscow Exchange pilot. Hitting that date would signal the infrastructure is ready, while a delay would suggest the plumbing needs more work. Finally, the payment prohibition caps how far this experiment can go. Trading is gaining legitimacy, but crypto's practical utility in the Russian economy stays boxed in until that rule changes, and nothing in the current framework suggests it will.

item.title: Jensen Huang rompe el silencio y dice que está dispuesto a volver a ser CEO de Nvidia
item.description: El exCEO afirmó que ha recibido solicitudes de empleados, inversores, socios comerciales y clientes para regresar al mayor fabricante de chips del mundo.
item.dc:creator: Ian King
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — El exCEO de Nvidia Corp. ( NVDA ), Jensen Huang, que renunció la semana pasada del mayor fabricante de chips del mundo, afirma que estaría dispuesto a volver a dirigir la empresa si el consejo de administración se lo permitiera. Ver más: Qué esperar del balance de Nvidia este 17 de noviembre de 2026: esto ven en Wall Street “Desde mi salida, he recibido una avalancha de peticiones por parte de los empleados, inversores, socios comerciales y clientes de Nvidia para que vuelva como CEO”, afirmó en un comunicado. “Si el consejo de administración decide que mi regreso redunda en beneficio de nuestros accionistas, nuestros empleados, la empresa y Estados Unidos, sería un honor para mí atender estas peticiones y volver como CEO”. La empresa rompió relaciones con Huang tras revelarse que había mantenido varias relaciones extramatrimoniales, incluida una con una mujer que, según se informa, el Gobierno de EE.UU. consideraba que espiaba para China. “No he estado a la altura de las expectativas que se tienen de todos en Nvidia y he cometido graves errores en mi vida personal”, afirmó Huang en el comunicado del martes. “He causado problemas al consejo de administración, lo cual lamento profundamente. Asumo plenamente la responsabilidad de mis errores y me comprometo a cooperar con la investigación independiente del consejo”. Desde su salida, el presidente Donald Trump y varios ejecutivos influyentes han pedido su regreso. En una publicación en las redes sociales, las firmas de inversión Altimeter Capital Management y Atreides Management citaron “el extraordinario éxito del liderazgo de Jensen Huang a lo largo de un extenso período” y la incertidumbre generada por su marcha para instar al consejo de administración a adoptar un enfoque “pausado, mesurado y deliberado” respecto al futuro liderazgo de Nvidia. Ver más: Nvidia enfrenta presión de EE.UU. por sus ventas de chips de IA a China y la salida de Huang Esto debería incluir “el posible regreso de Jensen Huang”, escribieron Brad Gerstner, de Altimeter, y Gavin Baker, de Atreides, en una carta dirigida al consejo de administración de Nvidia publicada en X. El CEO de SpaceX ( SPCX ) y Tesla Inc. ( TSLA ), Elon Musk, también ha expresado su apoyo a dicho regreso. Trump dijo que no le importaría la idea del regreso de Huang. “No me importaría”, declaró Trump a los periodistas el lunes. “Mucha gente le está preguntando a Jensen, creen que Jensen debería regresar. Ciertamente no es una mala idea”. Huang fue uno de los CEO con más años de servicio en la historia de Silicon Valley, transformando la empresa de fabricante de componentes para juegos de PC en la principal beneficiaria de la revolución de la IA. En el proceso, las ventas de Nvidia se dispararon a un nivel nunca antes visto en la industria de los semiconductores, y la compañía fue la primera en superar una valoración de US$5 billones. El consejo de administración de Nvidia se desvinculó oficialmente del cofundador de 63 años el 12 de noviembre, después de que la controversia en torno a sus asuntos se convirtiera en una crisis que abarcó Silicon Valley, Washington y Pekín. Legisladores estadounidenses han exigido explicaciones al ejecutivo sobre la supuesta trama de espionaje, mientras que Pekín ha negado haber intentado espiar a Huang. Nvidia nombró a la directora financiera, Colette Kress, como CEO interina mientras busca al reemplazo permanente de Huang. Además, ascendió al miembro de la junta directiva Harvey Jones al cargo de presidente, un puesto que Nvidia no había ocupado anteriormente. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Bitcoin falls below $70,000 as sell-off raises buying questions
item.description: Bitcoin has slipped below $70,000. For an asset that set a record of $124,773 in October 2025, that is quite a comedown.The world's largest crypto has since lost more than half its value. Investors ...
item.content:encoded:
News / Crypto Briefing / Bitcoin falls below $70,000 as sell-off raises buying questions

Bitcoin falls below $70,000 as sell-off raises buying questions 1 min read

BTCUSD Bitcoin has slipped below $70,000. For an asset that set a record of $124,773 in October 2025, that is quite a comedown. The world's largest crypto has since lost more than half its value. Investors cut exposure to volatile, speculative assets as economic and political uncertainty climbed. The break below $70,000 was not a one-day event. Bitcoin first dipped to roughly $67,600, then kept sliding. Over a weekend of heavy selling, it reached a low near $62,000. It then clawed back part of the loss and traded between $64,000 and $65,000. At those levels, Bitcoin's market capitalization sits around $1.29 trillion. The asset has now logged six straight weekly declines. ETF money headed for the exits. US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw outflows above $1 billion during a single week of the sell-off. BlackRock's IBIT, the biggest name in the category, was a notable source of the withdrawals. Leverage made it worse. Liquidations of leveraged positions topped $1.9 billion in a 24-hour window around the recent lows. Most of the damage hit traders betting on higher prices. Tech jitters spilled over. Risk appetite across markets weakened, with selling pressure tied to Nvidia among the visible stress points. Bitcoin has increasingly traded like a high-beta tech asset. Three signals stand out. First, ETF flows. Spot ETFs have become a key channel for institutional demand. A sustained return to inflows would suggest big allocators are stepping back in. Continued outflows would suggest the opposite. Second, the support zone. The range between $60,000 and $62,000 is the area now in focus for traders. Bitcoin already touched the top of that band during the weekend low and bounced. Third, the broader risk mood. Bitcoin's recent moves have tracked tech-stock sentiment and macro uncertainty closely. Economic data and the performance of names like Nvidia may say as much about Bitcoin's next move as anything happening on-chain. The $1.9 billion in liquidations is a reminder of how leverage turns a bad week into a terrible one.

(adds Dhoni's first names in paragraph eight) Nov 17 : Travis Head, Mitchell Starc, Jacob Bethell and Trent Boult were among the high-profile names released by their Indian Premier League franchises on Tuesday ahead of the IPL 2027 auction on December 16. Sunrisers Hyderabad and Delhi Capitals released Head and Starc respectively, with ESPNcricinfo saying the Australians want to manage their workloads amid a demanding schedule leading up to next year's One-Day International World Cup. Australia are due to play a four-test home series against New Zealand from December, followed by the Border-Gavaskar Trophy in India in January and the 150th anniversary test in March, before IPL 2027 begins.

After the league concludes, Australia could face an equally demanding run, with the World Test Championship final followed by the Ashes in England. Mumbai Indians released 13 players including New Zealand fast bowler Boult and India seamer Deepak Chahar. They also traded captain Hardik Pandya to Punjab Kings in exchange for left-arm seamer Arshdeep Singh ahead of IPL 2027. Holders Royal Challengers Bengaluru, who secured a second successive IPL title in 2026, retained Virat Kohli and captain Rajat Patidar.  Bethell, meanwhile, will miss IPL 2027 after suffering a setback in his recovery from injury. The England all-rounder has been sidelined since July and is set to undergo knee surgery, ruling him out of next month's tour of South Africa. Mahendra Singh Dhoni was released by Chennai Super Kings after bringing down the curtain on his IPL playing career and taking up a mentoring role with the franchise. All-rounder Prashant Veer was the most expensive player released as Chennai parted with him despite his 142 million rupees ($1.52 million) price tag. Head, whose previous retention fee was 140 million rupees, was the next most valuable player among those released. ($1 = 93.6450 Indian rupees)

item.description: [１７日 ロイター] - 米半導体エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は１７日、エヌビディア取...

item.content:encoded:
フアン氏、エヌビディアＣＥＯ復帰なら「光栄」　 取締役会判断次第 1:26 配信

エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン前ＣＥＯ。2024年6月2日、台北で撮影。REUTERS/Ann Wang/File Photo（ロイター） [１７日 ロイター] - 米半導体エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は１７日、エヌビディア取締役会が株主と同社にとり最善の利益になると判断すれば、ＣＥＯに復帰することは「光栄だ」と述べた。

フアン氏は声明で「エヌビディアの全員に期待されていた基準を満たせなかった上、私生活でも重大な過ちを犯した」とし、「取締役会に多大な迷惑をかけ、深く後悔している。私の過ちは全て私の責任だ」と述べた。

その上で、自身の辞任後、従業員や投資家、ビジネスパートナー、顧客から、ＣＥＯとして復帰を望む声が集まっていると説明。取締役会の独立調査に協力していく考えも示した。

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米企業在庫　9月は前月比0.5％増で予想と一致　内需対応で積み増し 1:15 配信

米イリノイ州グレンビューにあるＡＢＴエレクトロニクスの施設。2018年12月4日撮影。REUTERS/Richa Naidu（ロイター） [ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - 米商務省が１７日発表した９月の企業在庫は、前月比０．５％増加し、エコノミスト予想と一致した。堅調な国内需要に対応するため、企業が在庫を積み増したことが背景にある。

前年同月比では５．１％増加した。

在庫投資は、５四半期連続で減少した後、第３・四半期に反転した。第３・四半期（７─９月）の年率換算３．４％の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）成長率に対し、在庫は１．６１％ポイント寄与した。

９月の小売在庫は０．４％増。前月は横ばいだった。自動車在庫は０．２％増。前月は０．７％増だった。

ＧＤＰ算出に用いられる自動車を除く小売在庫は０．５％増と、先月公表された速報値の０．４％増から上方改定された。前月は０．２％減だった。

卸売在庫は０．７％増、製造業者の在庫は０．４％増だった。

企業売上高は１．８％増と、前月の１．２％増から伸びが加速した。

９月の販売ペースに基づく在庫解消に必要な期間は１．３３カ月と、前月の１．３５カ月から短縮した。前年同月は１．４２カ月だった。

item.description: [ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が１７日発表した１０月の製造業生産指数は前月比０．３％...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米製造業生産、10月は0.3％増と予想上回る　自動車・ＡＩ関連がけん引 0:56 配信

米ミシガン州ディアボーンにあるフォードの組み立て工場。2024年4月11日撮影。REUTERS/Rebecca Cook（ロイター） [ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が１７日発表した１０月の製造業生産指数は前月比０．３％増となった。自動車生産の急増や人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラ整備に関連する分野の伸びに支えられ、ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想（０．２％増）を小幅上回った。

１０月は前年同月比では２．２％増加した。

自動車・同部品の生産は４．４％上昇と、９月の２．７％減から反転した。これが耐久財製造業生産の伸びをけん引し、耐久財の生産は０．５％増加した。

半導体・関連電子部品の生産は２．２％増加、前年同月比では１５．３％増えた。コンピューター・周辺機器の生産は３．２％急増し、通信機器の生産は０．９％増加した。

非耐久財の生産は横ばい。９月は０．６％増加していた。

鉱業生産は０．８％減少した。９月は０．２％減だった。公益事業生産は、温暖な気候を背景に暖房需要が減少し、４．３％落ち込んだ。９月は４．４％増加していた。

鉱工業生産全体では０．４％減少し、９月の０．７％増から反転した。前年同月比では２．１％増だった。

鉱工業部門の設備稼働率は７６．４％と、９月の７６．８％から低下し、１９７２─２０２５年の平均を３．０％ポイント下回った。

製造業の稼働率は７６．０％と、９月の７５．９％から小幅上昇したものの、長期平均を２．２％ポイント下回っている。

item.title: FMI prevé menor crecimiento en Colombia y alerta sobre ajuste desordenado si no se corrigen cuentas fiscales
item.description: El organismo advirtió que la falta de medidas oportunas para estabilizar la deuda pública podría deteriorar la confianza de los inversionistas, elevar los costos de financiamiento y provocar una corre ...
item.dc:creator: Carlos Rodríguez Salcedo
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg Línea — El Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI) prevé una moderación del crecimiento económico de Colombia y advirtió que, sin un ajuste fiscal oportuno, el país podría enfrentar una corrección desordenada a través de los mercados financieros. Ver más: JPMorgan lanza los primeros ETF activos en la Bolsa de Colombia: cuáles son y en qué invierten La advertencia forma parte de las conclusiones preliminares de la misión del organismo que visitó Bogotá entre el 3 y el 13 de noviembre, en el marco de la consulta del Artículo IV de 2026, y que examinó los desequilibrios macroeconómicos y las prioridades de política económica. El equipo, encabezado por Ding Ding, jefe de la misión del FMI para Colombia, consideró urgente recuperar la disciplina fiscal, estabilizar la deuda pública y restablecer la confianza de los inversionistas , ante las elevadas necesidades de financiamiento y los compromisos de gasto del país. “Sin un ajuste adecuado y oportuno, la confianza se deterioraría, los costos de endeudamiento podrían aumentar aún más y el país podría, en última instancia, enfrentar un ajuste desordenado a través de los mercados financieros con graves implicaciones sociales y económicas”, advirtió Ding. El organismo reconoció la trayectoria de resiliencia económica de Colombia, respaldada por instituciones sólidas, un banco central independiente, un tipo de cambio flexible y un sistema financiero resistente. Sin embargo, identificó desequilibrios macroeconómicos y de política económica heredados, entre ellos una deuda pública elevada, importantes necesidades de financiamiento y compromisos de gasto que restringen el margen de acción fiscal. A estas presiones se sumaron las necesidades de reconstrucción derivadas del terremoto de agosto, que incrementaron las exigencias presupuestales cuando los márgenes de maniobra fiscal ya eran limitados. → Suscríbete al newsletter Línea de Mercado , una selección de Bloomberg Línea con las noticias bursátiles más destacadas del día. La misión destacó que el Gobierno de Abelardo de la Espriella comenzó a presentar una agenda orientada a recuperar la disciplina fiscal, la credibilidad de las políticas económicas y la confianza inversionista. Para el FMI, la prioridad inmediata consiste en mejorar decisivamente las finanzas públicas y restablecer la transparencia fiscal. Ding sostuvo que “establecer una trayectoria de consolidación fiscal ambiciosa, pero creíble, que estabilice la deuda pública, al tiempo que protege a los más vulnerables, es esencial para respaldar la confianza, reducir las vulnerabilidades de financiamiento y disminuir los costos de endeudamiento”. La propuesta de Ley de Rescate Económico del Ejecutivo “representa un paso importante en la dirección correcta”, dijo el FMI. El proyecto contempla racionalizar el gasto público, reducir las rigideces presupuestales, mejorar la eficiencia y progresividad del sistema tributario y fortalecer las instituciones fiscales y la transparencia. No obstante, el organismo condicionó la credibilidad y durabilidad del ajuste a la construcción de consensos que permitan conseguir la aprobación oportuna de un paquete equilibrado de medidas en el Congreso . Ver más: ¿Qué pasará con el precio del café en 2027? Las señales que anticipan una fuerte caída Las perspectivas de actividad económica también reflejan los efectos del ajuste macroeconómico. Ding explicó que “se espera que el crecimiento del PIB real se modere en el corto plazo a medida que la economía se ajusta a políticas macroeconómicas más restrictivas, con el gasto en reconstrucción proporcionando cierta compensación”. El comunicado no presentó una cifra específica de crecimiento para 2026 o 2027. En materia de inflación, el organismo anticipó que las presiones sobre los precios permanecerán elevadas en el corto plazo, debido al aumento de los costos laborales y al encarecimiento de los alimentos y la energía. Estas últimas presiones están asociadas al fenómeno de El Niño y a la guerra en Medio Oriente, dos factores que, según la misión, complican las perspectivas de desinflación de la economía colombiana. La expectativa es que la inflación disminuya gradualmente hacia la meta del 3%, apoyada por una política monetaria restrictiva y una mayor disciplina fiscal y de las políticas de ingresos. Estas medidas contribuirían a moderar las presiones de demanda interna, aunque el FMI advirtió que la evolución de los precios continúa expuesta a riesgos externos y climáticos. En el mediano plazo, el organismo considera que un marco de políticas creíble podría contribuir a recuperar la sostenibilidad fiscal, reducir los costos de financiamiento y ofrecer condiciones más previsibles para las empresas. Ver más: ¿Por qué el petróleo no ha provocado una crisis económica mayor? Goldman analiza el efecto en América Latina La misión también destacó que las reformas propuestas para reducir regulaciones y fortalecer la orientación de mercado podrían favorecer la inversión privada y elevar el crecimiento potencial de Colombia. Sin embargo, el panorama permanece sujeto a riesgos significativos, entre ellos condiciones financieras internacionales más restrictivas, mayor volatilidad de los precios de las materias primas y una intensificación de El Niño. Estos factores podrían afectar tanto el crecimiento económico como el proceso de reducción de la inflación, incluso si las autoridades avanzan en la implementación de las medidas previstas. La misión valoró el compromiso del Gobierno con la estabilidad macroeconómica y manifestó su disposición a continuar las conversaciones sobre el apoyo del FMI a la agenda de reformas. El siguiente paso será la preparación del informe de la consulta del Artículo IV, que deberá contar con la aprobación de la dirección del organismo antes de presentarse a su Directorio Ejecutivo para discusión y decisión.

item.title: 米金融システム技術革新を支援、伝統的決済も重要＝ウォラーＦＲＢ理事
item.description:
Michael S. Derby
[ニューヨーク １７日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のウォラー理事は１...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米金融システム技術革新を支援、伝統的決済も重要＝ウォラーＦＲＢ理事 0:46 配信

2026年9月3日、ウォラーＦＲＢ理事。REUTERS/Kylie Cooper（ロイター） Michael S. Derby

[ニューヨーク １７日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のウォラー理事は１７日、金融システムが人工知能（ＡＩ）エージェントを金融取引に安心して利用できるようになるには、なお長い道のりがあると述べた。

利用者の指示に基づいて自律的に動作する「エージェント型ＡＩ」について、消費者に大きな恩恵をもたらす可能性のある「興味深い技術だ」と指摘。ただ、「広く普及するまでには、解決しなければならない課題が数多くある」と述べた。ニューヨークでクリアリング・ハウスが主催したイベントで発言した。

ウォラー氏はまた、決済分野では現在、革命が起きていると指摘。決済システムが変化する中でも、銀行は引き続き重要な役割を果たすと述べた。

講演では「ＦＲＢは業界と定期的に関わり、その声に耳を傾け、全ての市場参加者が土台として活用できる中核的な決済・清算インフラを提供し、金融の安定に対するリスクを監視することを通じて、責任ある技術革新を引き続き支援していく」と表明した。

「市場原理だけでは重要な課題に対処できず、かつそれがわれわれの責務の範囲内にある場合、ＦＲＢは業界の『つなぎ役、取りまとめ役』として行動することができる」と述べた。

ウォラー氏はまた、決済分野で技術革新が続く中でも、既存のシステムには将来性があると語った。

民間の主体が新たなデジタル資産を生み出す中でも、「伝統的な決済の仕組みと、その上でやり取りされる各種の通貨は、決済システム全体への信頼を支える上で引き続き重要な役割を果たす」とし、「特に、中央銀行の通貨は全ての取引や全てのプラットフォームで使われる必要はないが、システムの土台にそれが存在することは不可欠だ」と述べた。

ウォラー氏は金融政策や経済見通しには言及しなかった。

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 17 : The highly classified network that the US National Security Agency uses for its internal communications is down, CNN reported on Tuesday, citing five people familiar with the matter. The agency was working to understand the scope of the problem, but there was no immediate evidence of a cyberattack, CNN reported. The NSA did not immediately return a message seeking comment about the reported outage. Reuters could not immediately determine the extent or the length of the outage. The report comes amid increased concern over a series of tech problems, notably faults that snarled US air traffic and triggered a Microsoft email blackout last week. US President Donald Trump on Tuesday played down the disruptions, saying such problems were inevitable. "Things like that happen," Trump told reporters in Manila when asked about the outages. "It's fine."

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米エヌビディアのフアン前ＣＥＯ、12月1日に下院委聴取＝外交委
item.description: [ワシントン １７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - 米下院外交委員会は１７日、米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が１２月１日に複数の下院委員会による記録作成を伴う聴取に応じることで合意したと発表した。

エヌビディアの法務責任者（ゼネラルカウンセル）、ティム・テター氏は１２月２日に同じ委員会の聴取に応じる。

両氏が対面で出席するのか、オンラインで参加するのかは現時点で不明。

声明によると、聴取を行うのは下院外交委員会、中国共産党に関する特別委員会、下院情報委員会。各委員会の委員長を務める共和党のブライアン・マスト氏、ジョン・ムーレナー氏、リック・クロフォード氏は声明で「国家安全保障が損なわれた可能性を巡り、ジェンスン・フアン氏らの関与について事情を聞きたい」と表明。「米国民は、危険な中国の関係者が米国の最先端半導体を入手できるようにしたフアン氏とエヌビディアの役割や、この不祥事における中国の情報機関の協力者と疑われる人物の役割について、説明を受ける必要がある」とした。

商務省で輸出管理を統括するジェフリー・ケスラー氏も出席するかとの質問に対し、マスト氏側から直ちにコメントは得られなかった。各委員会は先週、ケスラー氏にも出席を要請していた。同氏はエヌビディアのＡＩ半導体の中国への不正輸出阻止に向け、厳しい措置を講じていないとして批判を浴びている。

item.title: 米住宅建設業者指数、11月は14年半超ぶり低水準 金利高・労働力不足響く
item.description: [ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - 全米住宅建設業協会（ＮＡＨＢ）が１７日発表した１１月のＮＡＨＢ／ウェルズ・ファーゴ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米住宅建設業者指数、11月は14年半超ぶり低水準　金利高・労働力不足響く 0:32 配信

米カリフォルニア州サンディエゴにある新築一戸建て住宅。2025年3月11日撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake（ロイター） [ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - 全米住宅建設業協会（ＮＡＨＢ）が１７日発表した１１月のＮＡＨＢ／ウェルズ・ファーゴ住宅建設業者指数は２５と、前月から４ポイント低下し、２０１２年４月以来、１４年半超ぶりの低水準に落ち込んだ。住宅ローン金利の上昇により購入希望者が買い控えたことに加え、移民取り締まり強化に伴う労働力不足で建設業者のコストが膨らんだ。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は前月から横ばいの２９だった。

住宅金融機関フレディマックのデータによると、３０年固定住宅ローン金利は米国とイスラエルにより２月末の対イラン攻撃以降、１２０ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇し、１０月中旬には３年ぶり高水準となる平均７．４０％を付けた。その後、平均７．１８％まで低下している。

買い手を呼び込むために、今月値下げを実施した建設業者は約４６％と、新型コロナウイルス禍以降で最も高い割合となった。平均値下げ幅は６％と、８カ月連続で横ばいとなった。販売促進策の実施率は６８％と、これもコロナ禍以降で最も高い割合となった。

現在の販売状況を示す指数は前月比６ポイント低下の２８。今後の販売見通しを示す指数は２ポイント低下の３０となった。

見込み客の来場状況を示す指数は２ポイント低下の１６と、２０２０年の新型コロナ流行初期を除けば１５年ぶりの低水準となった。

ＮＡＨＢのビル・オーウェンズ会長は「移民取り締まりの強化により、合法的な労働者が建設現場から締め出され、労働力不足の深刻化によりコストが上昇している」と指摘。その上で「燃料価格の上昇を受け、下請け業者が料金を大幅に引き上げているほか、市場での購入者が減少し、建設を縮小する業者が増えている」と語った。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：ＡＩ投資に迫られる「総点検」、見えないリスクの把握急務に 焦点：「ＡＩの銀行」エヌビディア、ブームへ資金供給後退なら深刻な事態に 焦点：バイナンス63億ドル被害、ハッカー対策で問われる交換所の内部統制 アングル：ドル高支える年金基金のヘッジ巻き戻し、市場環境変化で懸念後退 アングル：今年はバリュー投資が活発化か、ＡＩバブル懸念で着目点変化 11/18(水) 0:32 最終更新 ロイター

Nov 17 : England batter Jacob Bethell will miss the tour of South Africa starting next month as he undergoes knee surgery, the England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB) said on Tuesday. • Bethell had injured his right knee and was set for a comeback on the current white-ball tour of Australia, but the 23-year-old was ruled out last week after a setback in training • “Jacob Bethell will undergo surgery on his right knee this week and has been ruled out of the tour of South Africa,” An ECB spokesperson said in an emailed statement. • The ECB has not given a timeline for Bethell's competitive return

FAST

TURIN, Italy, Nov 17 : France's Arthur Fils came from a set down to beat Rafael Jodar of Spain 4-6 6-2 6-2 at the ATP Finals on Tuesday and keep his semi-final hopes alive. Fils, who became the first man born in 2004 or later to earn an ATP Finals win and the first Frenchman to record a victory at the season-ending tournament in 15 years, lost his group opener against Ben Shelton. Jodar started well but faded midway through the second set and a medical timeout did not turn things around for him. The world number seven was pushing for a break, earning two opportunities in the third game and another at 4-4 in the first set but it was Jodar who snatched it with a break at 5-4.

The Spaniard, who has enjoyed a meteoric debut tour season, rising from the mid-hundreds to the world's top 10, kept stretching Fils with his elegant yet powerful and precise baseline play in a strong first set. Fils, however, kept his composure and bagged consecutive breaks to race into a 5-1 lead with Jodar calling for a medical timeout as his power level dropped sharply.  Fils cruised through the second set and kept hammering forehand winners past Jodar, who has now lost both matches following defeat by world number one Alexander Zverev on Sunday. The Spaniard was broken twice more in the third set and Fils sealed his first ATP Finals win with another booming serve that Jodar put into the net. In a repeat of the US Open final, Zverev will take on Shelton later on Tuesday.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Nov 17 : Anthropic's annual revenue could surge above $500 billion by 2030, New Street Research said on Tuesday, launching coverage of the AI company with a "buy" rating ahead of its highly anticipated IPO this week.  The brokerage also expects Anthropic's computing capacity to jump six-fold to 30 gigawatts (GW) by the end of the decade, from 5 GW in end-2026, driving its annual compute costs to nearly $314 billion.  • Anthropic's initial public offering is set to value the company at about $1.4 trillion and comes amid investor uncertainty around the AI trade • New Street Research set a 12-month price target of $105 on the stock, implying an about 35 per cent to 50 per cent upside to Anthropic's expected IPO price of $70 to $78

• New Street is the second brokerage to launch coverage on the stock, following Seaport Research Partners • "The IPO prices Anthropic on the cautious side, like mature hyperscalers and materially below high-growth infrastructure software publishers," New Street said • "We therefore see limited downside risk on the multiple, i.e., the stock performing in line with forward revenue growth," the brokerage added • New Street expects total revenue to rise to $505 billion by 2030, from $53 billion in 2026 • Anthropic has already secured more than $1 trillion worth of long-term compute agreements, the brokerage estimated • Those agreements correspond to 17 GW of contracted compute capacity by 2030, or more than half of the 30 GW New Street expects the company to deploy by then • "We don’t anticipate major financing needs for Anthropic," New Street said • The brokerage expects only about 20 per cent of the compute deployed through 2030 to require Anthropic's own capital spending, with cloud service providers and suppliers financing the major part of the rollout

item.title: エヌビディア、安保・輸出管理の監督委新設 中国事業に監視の目
item.description:
Jaspreet Singh
[１７日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディア
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Jaspreet Singh

[１７日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディア は１７日、安全保障と輸出管理を監督する取締役会レベルの委員会を設置した。不倫関係の発覚を受けてジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が辞任して以来、中国事業に対する監視の目が一段と厳しくなる中、同社にとって初の大規模なガバナンス（企業統治）改革となる。

中国のためにスパイ活動を行っていた疑いのある女性との関係を含め、フアン氏の不貞行為は、エヌビディアの監督体制が同社の急成長と米国の安全保障上の重要性の高まりに見合っていたのかという疑問を投げかけている。

エヌビディアによると、新設する「国家安全保障・輸出管理監督委員会」の委員長には、米ゴールドマン・サックスの元副会長で取締役のスザンヌ・ノラ・ジョンソン氏が就任する。また、法律事務所クーリーの元ＣＥＯであるスティーブン・ニール氏や、カリフォルニア工科大学の航空宇宙・機械工学教授、ジョン・ダビリ氏も同委員会の委員を務める。

エヌビディアのハービー・ジョーンズ取締役会会長は「われわれは、技術革新の継続を支えつつ、あらゆる手段を用いて安全保障を守る強固な枠組みの構築と推進に向け、政府や業界のパートナーと建設的に協力していくことに尽力する」と述べた。

トランプ米大統領はこの動きを歓迎し、委員会の設置を「良い考え」だと述べた。

同社は１７日の取引終了後に第３・四半期決算を発表する予定。

Russian lawmakers look to boost penalties for war-related offences

Reuters

17 November, 2026 08:30 pm IST

Follow Us:

Nov 17 (Reuters) – Russian lawmakers voted on Tuesday in favour of a bill that would increase fines for a slew of war-related and other minor offences, including “discrediting” the armed forces and distributing material the Kremlin deems extremist.

As the fifth anniversary of Moscow’s war in Ukraine nears, Russian authorities have snuffed out almost all public expressions of dissent against the conflict.

The State Duma, Russia’s lower house of parliament, passed the bill in the first of three readings. It would on average double the lower and upper limit of fines for 29 administrative offences related to public order and safety.

Show Full Article

These offences include holding unauthorised rallies, producing and distributing “extremist” material and public actions aimed at “discrediting the Russian Armed Forces” as well as smoking in certain areas and failing to properly register one’s residence.

“All of this should help to improve public safety for citizens,” the TASS state news agency quoted the Duma’s speaker, Vyacheslav Volodin, as saying.

Under the new proposals, producing and sharing “extremist” content, for example, would incur a fine of between 50,000 roubles and 100,000 roubles ($600 to $1,206) for individuals, up from just 1,000 to 3,000 roubles previously.

Moscow introduced sweeping wartime censorship laws soon after sending troops into Ukraine in February 2022, making it an offence to criticise the actions of Russian soldiers and labelling groups such as those linked to the late opposition figure Alexei Navalny as extremist.

Some 1,393 people have faced legal action for their anti-war stance since the start of the conflict, including 337 who are currently incarcerated or undergoing forced psychiatric treatment, according to Russian rights group OVD-Info.

($1 = 82.9149 roubles)

(Reporting by Lucy PapachristouEditing by Gareth Jones)

Congo’s Ebola outbreak is spreading and killing at a record pace

Reuters

17 November, 2026 08:30 pm IST

Follow Us:

By Jessica Donati DAKAR, Nov 16 (Reuters) – The Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo remains out of control six months after it was first declared, with case numbers and deaths still rising at a record pace.

Despite an outpouring of aid, resource shortages, insecurity and poor coordination hamper efforts to contain the outbreak, already the second-largest on record globally.

WHAT THE NUMBERS SHOW

Show Full Article

The outbreak, caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain of the virus, is spreading faster than any previous outbreak on record, alarming public health officials.

Over 11,000 people have been infected and over 5,500 have died since it was declared on May 15, according to government data.

Official data shows infections and deaths are rising at double the rate seen during the first six months of West Africa’s outbreak in 2014-16, the largest on record. In that outbreak, more than 28,600 people were infected and over 11,000 died, mostly in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone, according to the World Health Organization.

Congo has seen many Ebola outbreaks but never on this scale.

This is Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak and it already dwarfs the 2018-2020 outbreak, previously the largest on record in the Central African nation. That outbreak ended with 3,481 cases and 2,299 deaths recorded.

INSECURITY, POOR COORDINATION

Health workers, vehicles and surveillance teams have come under attack in communities that distrust outsiders.

WHO Director General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus told reporters on Tuesday that insecurity was among the greatest obstacles to the response.

The medical charity Médecins Sans Frontières said last week that vital resources and supplies still aren’t reaching hot spots outside the original epicenter in Ituri province.

Health workers have gone on strike over conditions and unpaid salaries, and some haven’t been paid since August, Congo government and health officials say. Tedros said the delay was slowing the response. Congo’s government says it is working to rectify the problem.

Some $2.9 billion has been pledged for the response but less than half of that has been disbursed, according to Africa’s top public health agency. It has urged donors to work closely with Kinshasa to avoid wastage through duplication.

(Additional reporting by Jennifer Rigby and Mariam Sunny; Editing by Robbie Corey-Boulet and Ros Russell)

Nov 17 : Tiger Woods will end more than two years away from official competition when he tees it up at next month's Hero World Challenge, an unofficial event he hosts in the Bahamas, organisers said on Tuesday. The 50-year-old, who hosts the 20-player event, has not competed in a world-ranking tournament since missing the cut at the 2024 British Open due to a combination of injuries, surgeries and legal complications. The Hero World Challenge is a 72-hole event with no cut. Woods had surgery to repair a nerve impingement on his lower back in September 2024 and then ruptured his Achilles tendon the following March while ramping up training at home, an injury that forced him to miss the 2025 season. He had another surgery in October 2025 to replace a disc in his lower back.

The 15-times major champion, regarded as the greatest golfer of his generation, returned to practice this year but his comeback attempt was derailed when he was arrested in March on a misdemeanor driving under the influence (DUI) charge after a rollover crash in Florida. Woods, one of the most famous athletes on the planet, has largely remained out of the public eye since his arrest and even spent time outside the US so he could seek treatment and focus on his health. Woods, who accepted a five-year suspension of his driver's licence in September after reaching a deal with prosecutors in his impaired-driving case, joins the Hero World Challenge field as one of three exemptions along with Rickie Fowler and 2019 US Open champion Gary Woodland. Woods also announced his return on Instagram, posting photos of the three golfers who will round out this year's field. The December 3-6 charity event that benefits Woods' foundation is not an official tournament on the PGA Tour schedule but does receive world ranking points.  World number one Scottie Scheffler, who won Hero World Challenge titles in 2023 and 2024, headlines this year's field. In total, six of the current top 10 in the world are among those in the field, a group that also includes Matt Fitzpatrick, Cameron Young, Chris Gotterup, Xander Schauffele and Sam Burns.

Source: Reuters

item.description: [北京 １７日 ロイター] - 中国商務省は１７日、米半導体大手エヌビディア製などの先端人工知能（ＡＩ）半導体への中...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国、米の対中先端ＡＩ半導体規則強化に反発　対抗措置警告 11/17 23:50 配信

2023年2月17日撮影。REUTERS/Florence Lo/Illustration/File Photo（ロイター） [北京 １７日 ロイター] - 中国商務省は１７日、米半導体大手エヌビディア製などの先端人工知能（ＡＩ）半導体への中国のアクセスを一段と制限する米国の新たな規制に断固として反対すると表明した。

同省は声明で、米国が新規則の施行に踏み切れば、対抗措置を講じるとも警告した。また、米国が協議や協力を通じて意見の相違を解決するという「正しい軌道」に戻ることを望むとの認識も示した。

トランプ政権は１６日、先端ＡＩ半導体への中国のアクセスを一段と制限すると発表。中国企業がＡＩモデルの学習に必要な計算能力を利用してきたタイやマレーシアなどのデータセンターへの先端半導体の出荷を制限する。また、中国に本社を置く企業に「大量の計算能力」を提供する海外データセンターにも新たな要件を課す。

トランプ大統領は今週、中国で習近平国家主席と会談する予定となっている。

JAKARTA: Indonesian police on Tuesday (Nov 17) dismissed an official named as a criminal suspect in a scheme to monitor phones belonging to President Prabowo Subianto and other officials, activists and journalists, a spokesperson said after an ethics hearing. Eko Hadi Santoso, a former police inspector general, underwent a nearly nine-hour ethics hearing over alleged abuse of power and using police facilities without a warrant, spokesperson Trunoyudo Wisnu Andiko said.  He was "dishonourably discharged" from the police force, Trunoyudo said after the hearing. Eko was arrested earlier this month, along with two other senior police officials, including former police chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo, who is not related to the president. A fourth official was named as a suspect .

From Habibie to Prabowo: A history of wiretapping controversies involving Indonesian presidents

The arrests followed accusations that officials were involved in widespread and unauthorised wiretapping of phones belonging to Prabowo, government officials, activists and journalists. The wiretapping scandal has exposed political tensions in Indonesia between Prabowo and his popular predecessor Joko Widodo, known as Jokowi, with Listyo widely regarded as a close Jokowi aide. The resignation of Jokowi's son Gibran Rakabuming Raka as vice president last week drew further attention to the rift. Listyo's ethics hearing will take place next week, police official Johnny Eddizon Isir said, without specifying the exact date.  Another police official and suspect, Ahrie Sonta, was fired last week after his ethics hearing.

Source: Reuters/dc

item.content:encoded:
News / Cointelegraph / Solana Foundation takes majority interest in crypto data firm CoinGecko

Solana Foundation takes majority interest in crypto data firm CoinGecko Less than 1 min read

SOLUSD Solana Foundation now holds a majority interest in crypto data aggregator CoinGecko, the foundation’s chief product officer, Vibhu Norby, said Tuesday. CoinGecko announced the backing but did not disclose the financial terms. It said it plans to use it to strengthen its data infrastructure, expand data coverage across tokenized real-world assets and derivatives, and develop onchain trading and market intelligence tools. The Solana Foundation “now has a majority interest in CoinGecko” and plans to collaborate on developing “new on-platform trading & DeFi experiences with Solana,” Norby said in a Tuesday X post. CoinGecko said its data methodologies would remain transparent and publicly accessible and that it would continue serving the broader crypto ecosystem. Its website, app and application programming interface, which supplies data to other services, will continue operating as usual. Founded in 2014, CoinGecko serves an average of over 10 million monthly users and receives over 200 million monthly page views, according to its About page. Cointelegraph has contacted the Solana Foundation and CoinGecko to ask about the size of the deal, but had not received a response by publication time.

item.description: [ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - 米労働省労働統計局が１７日に発表した１０月の輸入物価指数は前月比１．１％上昇し...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米10月輸入物価、前月比1.1％上昇と予想上回る　インフレ圧力の拡大示唆 11/17 23:44 配信

3月10日、米カリフォルニア州のロサンゼルス港で撮影。REUTERS/Caroline Brehman（ロイター） [ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - 米労働省労働統計局が１７日に発表した１０月の輸入物価指数は前月比１．１％上昇した。伸びは関税を除く輸入物価のエコノミスト予想（０．７％上昇）を上回り、インフレ圧力がエネルギー関連商品以外にも広がりつつあることを改めて示唆した。

昨年１０月は連邦政府機関の閉鎖によりデータが収集されなかったため、労働省は前年比での変化率は公表しなかった。

１０月の輸入物価は、輸入燃料価格が前月比３．６％上昇したことがけん引した。９月は６．３％増だった。

輸入食品価格は０．２％下落し、９月の０．４％上昇から反転した。

輸入資本財価格は１．５％急騰。非電気機械価格が１．７％上昇したことがけん引した。これは人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラの拡充に関連している公算が大きい。

輸入自動車・部品・エンジンの価格は０．４％上昇。９月は０．３％上昇だった。自動車を除く輸入消費財の価格は０．５％上昇。９月は０．３％上昇だった。

燃料と食品を除くコア輸入価格は０．９％上昇。９月は０．５％上昇していた。

Nov 17 : Former England and Manchester United striker Wayne Rooney contemplated suicide during his playing career, he said in a podcast episode released on Tuesday. One of the country's most decorated players, Rooney spent the early years of his career battling mental health issues and alcoholism, he told the "Life at the Midpoint" podcast. "It took until my mid-20s, until I hit rock bottom (before I started feeling comfortable with myself)," Rooney, 41, said. "I'd go home and lock myself in the house for two days, and just drink. Probably at the best part of my career playing-wise."
