"I got to a place where you're contemplating suicide. You just didn't want to be around anyone. I didn't want to see people in the streets. I didn't want to go into shops." Rooney said it pushed his marriage to breaking point but wife Coleen was key in his recovery. Even so, he said he did not feel alcohol abuse affected his performances on the pitch. "I was always comfortable on a football pitch, but everything else (I) really struggled with it." Although Rooney eventually attended therapy sessions, he said the culture around mental health and masculinity in football prevented him from seeking help earlier. "You don't want to show any weakness, so you try to mask it," he said. "Even though I knew the position I was in, it was difficult to actually admit that I was in that position because I felt like you feel less of a man, if you like, for doing that." Rooney retired from playing football in 2021 and has since worked as a manager, most recently for Plymouth Argyle in 2024. His managerial career has been shared with punditry, and Rooney is currently appearing on British reality TV show "I'm a Celebrity Get Me Out of Here".

Source: Reuters

WASHINGTON, Nov 17 : A recent series of US technology outages is not tied to cyberattacks but rather to aging computer systems that are in need of upgrades, the country's top homeland security official said on Tuesday. Disruptions at United Airlines, the Federal Aviation Administration, Microsoft and JPMorgan Chase have raised alarm. "Some of the technology that they're pushing out there, they're pushing new technology on top of really old computer systems, and it just seems to overwhelm the system," Markwayne Mullin told CNBC. "But it has nothing to do with cyberattacks, and I believe we're going to see more of this as new technology rolls out." Mullin said maybe companies needed to start telling customers before conducting a scheduled upgrade and warn them of possible disruptions for a short period of time.

"I can tell you 98 per cent certainty this isn't a cyberattack," he added. Mullin said that at 2:20 p.m. ET on Tuesday there would be a long-scheduled test of the emergency alert system. Radio and television broadcasters nationwide will interrupt normal programming to relay a one-minute test message. The FAA issued a nearly five-hour ground stop on Friday that led to airlines cancelling more than 18,000 flights over three days in the longest outage since the September 11, 2001, attacks. The outage was blamed on the installation of a single router in a remote facility in Arkansas. United said a computer problem on Monday forced a halt to many departing flights, while JPMorgan Chase, the largest US lender, on Monday experienced problems processing transactions due to a software bug but said there was no evidence it was cyber-related. Microsoft on Saturday said services had fully recovered across Teams, Outlook and its other products, ending a global outage that crippled online communications for businesses and governments for over 24 hours. Microsoft said server issues were behind the incident and it was not aware of any malicious activity.

South Korea to check students after exam candidate used AI to cheat

Reuters

17 November, 2026 08:00 pm IST

By Heejin Kim and Hyunsu Yim SEOUL, Nov 17 (Reuters) – South Korea will tighten checks on students taking the high-stakes national university entrance exam this week, Prime Minister Han Seong-sook said, after a candidate in another test confessed to using a hidden camera and AI to cheat.

Authorities will place stickers on the buttons of candidates’ clothing to cover up any miniature cameras hidden inside during the annual College Scholastic Ability Test, Han told a press conference on Tuesday.

The government ordered the crackdown after a man who got the top score in the national exam for tax accountants said on Sunday he had taken photos of the questions and sent them to an AI tool, which then sent back answers to a smartphone.

Show Full Article

His confession sparked a national scandal and raised questions over the credibility of national exams.

Authorities will check students’ collars for concealed devices and use metal detectors, Han said.

Glasses worn by students will be inspected to ensure that they are not smart glasses, which can be used to photograph or film material.

Cheating on exams using advanced equipment was no different from the “theft” of the hard work of other students, President Lee Jae Myung said in a post on X.

“If any of you are considering cheating on an exam … please abandon the idea,” Lee said.

Exam participants will be required to leave bags and personal belongings in corridors outside the examination rooms.

South Korean authorities plan to seek cooperation from technology companies to investigate whether there is evidence that exam questions were captured and sent to generative AI apps during the test, Han said.

Nearly 8,400 additional exam inspectors are due to be deployed at exam sites nationwide, according to the prime minister.

The government will extend from one year to a decade a ban on retaking the exam for those caught cheating, she said.

($1 = 1,337.1000 won)

(Reporting by Heejin KimEditing by Ed Davies and Andrew Heavens)

item.title: イランが米首都で「汚い爆弾」計画との報道、深刻に受け止め＝トランプ氏
item.description: [ドバイ １７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ドバイ １７日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１７日、イランが米首都ワシントンで放射性物質を飛散させる「ダーティーボム（汚い爆弾）」による攻撃を計画している可能性があるとの報道について、米国は深刻に受け止めていると述べた。

米ＣＮＮが米情報機関の情報として報じた。

トランプ大統領は訪問先のマニラで記者団から同報道について問われ、「調査中だ」と述べた。差し迫った脅威があるかとの質問に対しては、「もしそうであれば、イランはこれまでどの国も払ったことのないような代償を払うことになるだろう」と警告した。

その上で、差し迫った脅威がないことを願うとしつつも、「彼らは尋常ではない。われわれはこの問題を極めて深刻に受け止めている」と語った。

イラン外務省報道官はＸへの投稿で、「根拠がない」として報道を否定した。

item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - 米セントルイス地区連銀のムサレム総裁は１７日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
インフレ抑制へ複数回利上げ必要の公算、早期対応重要＝米セントルイス連銀総裁 11/17 23:29 配信

２０２５年５月撮影　REUTERS/Ann Saphir（ロイター） Howard Schneider

[ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - 米セントルイス地区連銀のムサレム総裁は１７日、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）はインフレ抑制に向け複数回の利上げを実施する必要がある可能性が高いとし、インフレがさらに悪化するのを防ぐために早期に行動しなくてはならないとの考えを示した。

ムサレム氏は、フェデラルファンド（ＦＦ）金利誘導目標の現行水準（３．７５－４．００％）について、インフレ率をＦＲＢが目標とする２％に戻すために必要な水準を最大１％ポイント下回っているとの見方を示し、「適時に物価安定を達成するために２０２７年春までに複数回の利上げが必要になる可能性が高い」と指摘。現在のインフレ率は３％を上回って推移しており、ＦＲＢが対応しなければ高止まりが続く公算が大きいと述べた。

ＦＲＢは１２月８─９日に開く次回の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定すると広く予想されている。ムサレム総裁は今年のＦＯＭＣで投票権を持っていない。

米10月小売売上高0.2％増、高額商品の買い控えで伸び緩やか 11/17 23:19 配信

2025年11月26日、米ニューヨーク市のスーパーマーケットで撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon（ロイター） [ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - 米商務省が１７日発表した１０月の小売売上高（季節調整済）は前月比０．２％増と、ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想と一致した。物価上昇を背景に、家計が自動車やその他の高額商品の購入を手控えたものの、それ以外の支出は維持されており、第４・四半期開始時点で経済が底堅さを保っていることが示された。

９月は０．８％増（改定なし）だった。

１０月は前年同月比では６．８％増加した。

物価上昇が家計の予算を圧迫する中でも、消費は底堅さを維持している。小売売上高の底堅さに加え、同日発表された１０月の輸入物価が予想を上回る伸びを示したことで、広く予想されている１２月の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での利上げ後も、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げを続けるとのエコノミストの見方が強まった。

個人消費は主に高所得層の家計に支えられてきた。これらの家計は株価上昇を背景にインフレの打撃を和らげてきたものの、足元のハイテク株主導の売り圧力は、消費者の慎重さを強め、支出を抑制する可能性がある。

１０月の自動車販売店の売上高は１．６％減少。家具の売上高は２．３％減少、電子機器・家電販売は横ばいだった。衣料品店のほか、スポーツ用品・趣味・楽器・書籍店でも売上高が減少した。一方、建設資材は０．５％増加。オンライン小売店の売上高は１．２％増加した。外食・飲食は０．２％増加した。

自動車、ガソリン、建設資材、外食サービスを除くコア小売売上高は前月比０．６％増と、伸びはエコノミスト予想（０．４％増）を上回った。９月は０．１％増から０．５％増に上方改定された。

ＢＭＯキャピタル・マーケッツの米国チーフエコノミスト、スコット・アンダーソン氏は「物価の急上昇で苦しむ消費者が増えているのは明らかだが、まだ諦めているわけではない」と指摘。「むしろ消費者は、毎月の予算を戦略的に配分し、さまざまな支出項目で資金をやりくりしているようだ。一定の圧力があるものの、第４・四半期の実質個人消費は、ＦＲＢがインフレ対応という責務に注力し続けられるのに十分な堅調さを示すと予想される」と語った。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：協調介入の米関与は限定的の受け止め、円再び160円台に　安値試しも 焦点：米財政運営巡る政治対立リスク、民主党勝利で市場が注目 アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 11/18(水) 2:52 最終更新 ロイター

The AI data center developer's announcement is the latest among technology companies and cloud providers, who are expanding their capacity to meet soaring demand for artificial intelligence computing. French robot maker Genesis raises $500 million at $3.5 billion valuation

Eno, a general-purpose AI robot made by French robotics startup Genesis AI, reaches for a box on a conveyor belt at a warehouse in Sunnyvale, California, U.S., June 9, 2026. Genesis AI/Handout via REUTERS

FAST

Nov 17 : French robotics startup Genesis AI has raised $500 million in a funding round valuing it at $3.5 billion, the company said on Tuesday, one of the biggest funding rounds in Europe's robotics sector as investors bet on demand for AI-enabled factory robots. Backers included former Google CEO Eric Schmidt, Silicon Valley venture capital firm Khosla Ventures and French tech entrepreneur Xavier Niel, as well as Nvidia and French state-backed investor Bpifrance. Khosla Ventures, Premji Invest and Eclipse co-led the Series A round. CEO Zhou Xian said Genesis would use the money to increase production of Eno, its flagship general-purpose robot, expand its data collection and AI training, and improve the robot's ability to manipulate objects with its hands. Eno's design features three body segments resembling oversized playing cards, mounted on a rotating wheeled base.

This allows it to fold into a compact space before popping up to reach roughly human heights when working, like a jack-in-the-box. The company said it put particular emphasis on developing dexterous hands, one of the hardest technical challenges facing robot makers. "I don't understand why robots need a head because ... it doesn't even have a brain living there," Zhou said, explaining why Genesis rejected a more human-like form. Co-founded by former Mistral AI researcher Théophile Gervet, Genesis is among a growing group of Europe-based robotics companies valued at more than $1 billion and targeting industrial work, alongside Britain's Humanoid and Germany’s Neura Robotics, Agile Robots and RobCo. Genesis is developing its AI, hardware and training systems together, seeking to shorten its test cycles. It designs components including actuators, motors, gearboxes and hands, while using Nvidia computing chips. Zhou said Genesis was initially prioritising the United States, with plans for a US supply chain, American contract manufacturers and customers before expanding more broadly in Europe. The company, which also has a headquarters in San Carlos, California, is testing a small number of robots with customers. It has a partnership with South Korea's LG CNS to test Eno for manufacturing and logistics. Genesis expects a wider customer rollout in 2027, Zhou said.

Source: Reuters

China slams new US chip curbs, vows 'necessary measures'

Washington announced new restrictions on AI chip exports which will require data centres anywhere in the world to have a US licence to provide large volumes of computing power from advanced chips to companies headquartered in China and several other countries.

National flags of China and the United States flutter on a road, ahead of US President Donald Trump's state visit to China, in Beijing, China, on May 13, 2026. (File photo: Reuters/Tingshu Wang)

FAST

BEIJING: China condemned on Tuesday (Nov 17) new United States curbs on chip exports and vowed to take "necessary measures" after Washington moved to close a loophole under intense scrutiny following the Nvidia spy scandal. Washington announced new restrictions on Monday on AI chip exports which will require data centres anywhere in the world to have a US licence to provide large volumes of computing power from advanced chips to companies headquartered in China, Macau or other countries under US arms embargoes. The rules also require licences to ship advanced chips to Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil - countries the US commerce department says present a "higher-than-normal risk of diversion" of the chips. Beijing's foreign ministry denounced the curbs on Tuesday. "The US repeatedly overstretches the concept of national security, abusing export control measures," ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun told a news briefing, vowing that China will "take necessary measures to resolutely safeguard its legitimate rights and interests". The country's commerce ministry also expressed "firm opposition" to the new restrictions, urging the US to "return to the right track of resolving differences" through consultation and cooperation. "Such actions ... undermine market rules and the international economic and trade order, and threaten the stability of global semiconductor industrial and supply chains," the ministry said in a statement late Tuesday, also threatening Washington with countermeasures.

Source: Reuters/ao

FAST

BOSTON, Nov 17 : US data center operators and other big power users can cut millions of dollars from their electricity bills by sharply reducing their use of grid power during a handful of crucial hours each year, a practice drawing scrutiny as household power bills rise. The practice, known as peak shaving, is legal and encouraged under US power-market rules and state tariffs. But critics say it can allow large power users to reduce their share of grid costs in ways unavailable to households, raising questions about how those costs are divided. Those questions have taken on greater urgency as the rapid growth of power-hungry AI data centers adds to the cost of expanding the electricity system. Rising power bills became a campaign issue in states including Texas in this month's midterm elections, and regulators are considering changes to the rules governing how grid costs are allocated. Residential customers generally don't have the same opportunities to cut grid-related charges as large users, said Will Baker, head of market development at Everyday Electric, which provides power services for homes.

"A factory has an energy manager, interval data, and a capacity charge that rewards every kilowatt it shaves. A household has none of those," Baker said. The potential savings for large users can be enormous. A large data center in Texas can avoid $33.4 million in transmission costs by staying off the grid for just one hour a year, either by reducing power use or firing up backup generators, according to Houston-based NRG Energy.  That's because grid costs are allocated in part according to electricity use during periods of highest demand. The rapid growth of energy-hungry data centers has already increased power-system costs by $29.4 billion across PJM Interconnection, the largest US grid, according to PJM's independent monitor. Those costs are reflected in charges paid by utilities and ultimately passed on to electricity customers. NRG says any rule changes on how grid charges are allocated should reduce the potential for cost shifting to residential customers. UNFAIR BURDEN Bailey Wells, a residential customer in Spring, Texas, saw her monthly electric bill climb to nearly $600 this past summer, compared to her previous all-tme summer high of about $500. "This was unprecedented for my household," Wells said. "I understand that large electricity users may have opportunities to reduce their transmission costs by curtailing electricity use during ... peak-demand periods. It's reasonable to question whether that creates an unfair burden for people who have little or no control over when they use electricity." The Data Center Coalition said peak shaving can reduce grid demand when supply is tightest. "Grid operators can count on those reductions in planning," it said in a statement. "Less new capacity and transmission must be built, which lowers costs for all customers." Big Tech companies say they want to pay their fair share, but they are also pushing back on proposed requirements. Google, for example, complained to Texas utility regulators about a scenario in which the company would pay about $1.4 billion in transmission charges over 20 years, according to an August filing with the Public Utility Commission of Texas. PREDICTING THE PEAK Data centers and other large customers hire forecasters to alert them when they should curb power consumption on the most likely days, since operators don't post summer peak hours in advance. Correctly predicting the peak can reduce their capacity and transmission charges for the following year. Andrew Major, a lawyer at the Virginia State Corporation Commission, a state utilities regulator, said in July testimony that residential customers paid 48 per cent, the largest share, for a transmission project serving a data center. Dominion Energy, whose territory includes Virginia, said it has taken steps to ensure fair play, such as creating a new rate class that mostly consists of data centers. Those rules would require new data centers to sign 14-year contracts and make minimum payments if they don't use the power, steps aimed at leveling the playing field.

(Reporting By Tim McLaughlin; editing by Timothy Gardner and Sanjeev Miglani)

Source: Reuters

(Corrects last paragraph to say Google trial started in October, not due to start) LONDON, Nov 17 : Sony fought off a London lawsuit worth almost £2 billion ($2.6 billion) that alleged the PlayStation maker's "monopoly position" inflated prices for digital games, after a tribunal dismissed the claim in its entirety. The lawsuit accused the Japanese conglomerate of abusing its dominant position by requiring digital games and add-ons for its console to be bought and sold only via its PlayStation Store, making prices higher than for physical games. Sony, however, said during the trial it had "invested years and billions" in an integrated gaming platform that benefits consumers in a competitive market, where rivals Nintendo and Microsoft's Xbox use similar models.

London's Competition Appeal Tribunal dismissed the claim in its entirety on Tuesday after a trial which began in March, ruling that the claimant class had failed to establish that Sony infringed competition law. Stephanie Burns, Senior Vice President and General Counsel at Sony Interactive Entertainment said the ruling affirms the company's business model. Lawyers representing the class action did not immediately responded to a request for comment. BIG TECH UNDER SCRUTINY The case was the third against a major tech company to go to trial since the start of 2025 as Britain's burgeoning class action-style regime builds momentum. It follows a successful case against Apple in October last year and a case against chipmaker Qualcomm, which was withdrawn after trial but before the tribunal gave its ruling. Lawyers representing the claimant class against Sony told the tribunal in March: "Sony can and does set the retail prices ... without facing any retail competition for digital content. It allows it to obtain monopoly profits from digital distribution." But Sony, which sold 8 million PlayStation 5 consoles globally between October and December 2025, said the lawsuit amounted to arguing that third parties should be allowed to set up a store for the PlayStation and "free-ride" on Sony's investments. Its lawyers also argued the margin Sony earns on sales of games and additional content is not excessive, saying the lawsuit ignores the company's costs and the value of its brand. The tribunal ruled against Apple in relation to its App Store last year, a decision Apple is seeking to appeal. A trial of a lawsuit against Google began in October. Fortnite maker Epic Games, which would have been involved in that case, withdrew its claim after Google announced sweeping changes to its Play Store practices. ($1 = 0.7580 pounds)

Source: Reuters

item.title: 日米豪印、経済的威圧に「深刻な懸念」 トランプ氏会合初出席
item.description:
Trevor Hunnicutt Karen Lema Mikhail Flores
[マニラ １７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Trevor Hunnicutt　Karen Lema　Mikhail Flores

[マニラ １７日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１７日、アジア歴訪の最初の訪問国であるフィリピンの首都マニラで開かれた日米豪印４カ国の枠組み「クアッド（ＱＵＡＤ）」首脳会合に出席した。

２年ぶりとなる首脳会合の冒頭、トランプ大統領は「われわれ４カ国は、自由で開かれ、安定し繁栄するインド太平洋を四方から支えている」とした上で、「われわれは極めて良好な関係を築いており、安全保障や経済安全保障、外交上の課題に緊密に連携して取り組んでいる」と述べた。

トランプ大統領とっては、同会合への初の出席となった。クアッド会合に出席した高市早苗首相は冒頭、協力の枠組みをさらに発展させるよう呼びかけた。

会合後に発表された共同プレスリリースは「緊張を高め、地域の平和と安定を損ない、現状変更を試みるあらゆる一方的な行動に強く反対する」と表明。さらに、「恣意的な輸出規制を含む経済的威圧に深刻な懸念を表明する」とした。

特定の国名には言及していないものの、レアアース（希土類）の輸出を巡る中国の制限を巡り、日米などは不満を表明している。

首脳はまた、人工知能（ＡＩ）の開発・普及に向けた取り組みの調整や資金拠出を進めるＡＩ加速化計画へのコミットメントを改めて確認した。

トランプ大統領は「この重要技術の未来を、われわれと価値観や共通の利益を共有する国々が主導し、可能な限り最良のものにしたい」と述べた。

プレスリリースには海洋安全保障分野での協力強化も盛り込まれ、各国の哨戒機が来年、海上で初の共同飛行訓練を実施する計画が記された。

トランプ大統領はクアッド首脳会合後、米・東南アジア諸国連合（ＡＳＥＡＮ）特別首脳会議に出席するほか、タイとの首脳会談で相互貿易協定に関する共同声明に署名する見通し。フィリピンのマルコス大統領とも会談する。

こうした中、マニラではトランプ氏訪問への抗議活動が５日目に入り、デモ参加者が集まった。これまでの抗議ではトランプ氏をかたどった人形が燃やされたほか、中東での戦争の終結や、米国主導のサプライチェーン（供給網）構想「パックス・シリカ」の撤廃を求める声が上がった。

トランプ大統領は１８日にアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議が開かれる中国・深圳に向かう。１９日には当地で米中首脳会談、米中ロ首脳会談が予定されている。

FAA pauses Juniper router deployment after grounding US flights

Travelers crowd a terminal as flight delays continue amid FAA measures more than a month into the ongoing U.S. government shutdown, at O’Hare International Airport in Chicago, Illinois, U.S., November 10, 2025. REUTERS/Chris Helgren

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 17 : The US Federal Aviation Administration said on Tuesday it was immediately pausing deployment of additional Juniper routers pending further testing after a nationwide ground stop last week led to the cancellation of more than 18,000 flights. A group of 13 Democratic senators had urged the FAA to stop deploying the Juniper routers pending testing. Hewlett Packard Enterprise, which owns Juniper Networks, did not immediately comment. Its shares fell 2.8 per cent. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said on Monday it remained unclear why a Juniper router installed by L3Harris Technologies in a remote Arkansas facility triggered a nearly five-hour nationwide aviation ground stop, the longest in the United States since the September 11, 2001 attacks. The incident disrupted the travel plans of hundreds of thousands of passengers.

"Based on information provided to our offices from L3 Harris, the copper-to-fiber transition involves converting 3,648 routers to Juniper devices. To date, it is our understanding that 400 devices have been installed, and 69 are operational," wrote the 13 Democratic senators on the Senate Commerce Committee led by Maria Cantwell, a Washington state Democrat.  "With thousands of conversions remaining, FAA must address outstanding safety and reliability concerns before expanding installation," the senators wrote. "Congress expects clear, fact-based answers about the root cause of this disruption and why existing safeguards failed to prevent it." TRANSPORTATION SECRETARY TO BRIEF SENATORS Duffy is set to brief senators on Tuesday. The government blamed the mass flight shutdown on the L3Harris router installation. L3Harris, which did not immediately comment on Tuesday, has said it is cooperating with the official investigation into what went wrong.  Duffy said the installation at an FAA radio communications site in El Dorado, Arkansas, led to an overload of a key government communications system at a rate of 1,000 connection attempts every four to five seconds. That destabilized aircraft communications and radar feeds, affecting 17 of 22 FAA en route air traffic control centers that were using old routers and prompting the ground stop, Duffy said. The FAA said on Sunday the initial investigation suggested the data overload could have happened in two locations: the El Dorado site and a radar site in Amarillo, Texas. Duffy said L3Harris replaced the router in Amarillo three weeks earlier.  "Deployment should resume after the FAA demonstrates the devices’ readiness for safe deployment through improved operational testing, independent validation, verified fail over capability, and rollback procedures," the senators wrote. Duffy said testing of the two routers was taking place at an L3Harris lab in Florida. The FAA said after the data "inconsistencies" occurred, L3Harris ultimately blocked those two locations, stabilizing the network. The broadcasting function was disabled on the new routers as well as 60 other routers in the system as a precaution.

Source: Reuters

item.description: [台北 １７日 ロイター] - 世界最大の電子機器受託製造会社、鴻海（ホンハイ）精密工業は１７日、ソニーセミコンダク...

item.content:encoded:
鴻海、ソニーの車載カメラ事業買収へ　72.4億円 11/17 20:58 配信

鴻海精密工業のロゴ、台北で開催された同社の年次イベントで10月30日撮影 REUTERS/Tsai Hsin-Han（ロイター） [台北 １７日 ロイター] - 世界最大の電子機器受託製造会社、鴻海（ホンハイ）精密工業は１７日、ソニーセミコンダクタソリューションズの車載カメラモジュール事業を７２億４０００万円（４５４８万ドル）で買収する計画を発表した。

海外の生産設備や在庫など、その他の資産について協議が続いており、買収価格は変更される可能性があるとした。

同事業が持つ既存の技術や顧客基盤、自動車メーカーに直接サービスを提供してきた経験を活用し、車載電子機器やスマートモビリティー分野での事業拡大を目指す。

今回の買収により、自動車向けの総合的なサービス提供能力と競争優位性を強化し、世界の自動車メーカーにより大きな価値を提供できると説明した。

規制当局の承認などを条件に４月末までに買収を完了する見通し。

item.description: [ベルリン／フランクフルト １７日 ロイター] - スペイン出身で国際決済銀行（ＢＩＳ）のデコス総支配人が欧州中央銀...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢ人事、デコス氏が次期総裁に一歩前進　独が支持に回る 11/17 20:56 配信

フランクフルトのECB本部、2022年撮影 REUTERS/Wolfgang Rattay/File Photo（ロイター） [ベルリン／フランクフルト １７日 ロイター] - スペイン出身で国際決済銀行（ＢＩＳ）のデコス総支配人が欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の次期総裁就任に一歩近づいた。ドイツが同氏の支持に回り、ＥＣＢのチーフエコノミストのポストを求める意向を示した。

独財務省は１７日、ＥＣＢのチーフエコノミストにプリンストン大学のマルクス・ブルンナーマイヤー教授を推す方針を明らかにした。関係筋がロイターに語ったところによると、ドイツはＥＣＢ総裁にデコス氏を支持する。

こうした人事が実現すれば、シュナーベル専務理事が１月上旬に退任した後の空席はフランスが得るとみられる。

理事の担当を正式に決めるのはＥＣＢ総裁だが、エコノミストらによると、フランスは自国の債券市場の混乱を踏まえ、シュナーベル氏が担う市場操作の担当を引き継ぐことに関心を持つ可能性がある。市場操作には中央銀行の債券購入プログラムが含まれる。

独政府は１８日にブルンナーマイヤー氏の指名を承認する予定だ。同日は、各国政府がユーロ圏財務相会合（ユーログループ）に候補者を届け出る期限となっている。

TAIPEI, Nov 17 : Foxconn, the world's biggest contract electronics manufacturer, plans to acquire Sony Semiconductor Solutions' automotive camera module business for 7.24 billion yen ($45.48 million), it said in a statement on Tuesday. • Foxconn said the purchase price could change as other assets such as overseas production equipment and inventory were still being discussed • It said that it intends to leverage the existing technologies, customer base, and direct-to-automaker service experience of the camera module business to expand its presence in automotive electronics and smart mobility • Foxconn said the acquisition will enable it to strengthen its integrated automotive service capabilities, enhance its competitive advantage and deliver greater value to global automotive clients • The deal is expected to close by end-April, subject to regulatory approvals and other conditions, Foxconn said ($1 = 159.1800 yen) (Reporting By Lee Wen-Yee; Editing by Andrew Heavens, Kirsten Donovan)

Source: Reuters

item.title: EXCLUSIVE-米政権、中国製光通信機器の輸入阻止へ ＩＴ大手反発でも
item.description:
Alexandra Alper David Shepardson
[ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - 関係者によると...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
EXCLUSIVE-米政権、中国製光通信機器の輸入阻止へ　ＩＴ大手反発でも 11/17 20:37 配信

米インディアナ州にあるアマゾン・ウェブ・サービス（AWS）のAIデータセンター、2025年10月撮影 REUTERS/Noah Berger for AWS/File Photo（ロイター） Alexandra Alper　David Shepardson

[ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - 関係者によると、トランプ米政権は、国内のテクノロジー大手の反発にもかかわらず、中国製データセンター機器の輸入阻止に向けた取り組みを進める方針だ。

ロイターは８月、米連邦通信委員会（ＦＣＣ）が国家安全保障上の懸念から、中国製光トランシーバーの新機種の輸入禁止を目指していると報じた。光トランシーバーは、データセンター内の光ファイバーケーブルを通じて光の速度でデータを伝送できるようにする機器。

ただ、この措置に反対する企業は、これまで知られていたよりも多い。アマゾン、アルファベット傘下のグーグル、メタ、コアウィーブ、シスコは今年、マイクロソフトとともに、ホワイトハウス当局者との会合に参加した。会合について知る関係者２人によると、各社の幹部は、こうした措置への対応に米企業は最大１０年を要する可能性があると伝えた。

輸入禁止措置の実施を疑問視する見方もあったが、別の関係者３人によると、計画は進んでいる。

一段と強い措置を求める動きの背景には、米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と中国のスパイとされる人物との不倫疑惑の浮上がある。疑惑を受け、米政界では中国の技術がもたらす脅威に対し、より厳しい姿勢を求める声が再び強まっている。

米政界の対中強硬派は、中国製光トランシーバーが、中国政府による米データセンターからのデータ窃取やマルウエアのインストール、サービス妨害に利用される恐れがあると懸念している。

ＦＣＣ、アマゾン、グーグル、メタ、コアウィーブ、シスコはコメント要請に回答しなかった。マイクロソフトはコメントを控えた。ホワイトハウス当局者は、企業側の働きかけや措置の進捗状況についてコメントを控えたが、中国の技術やその他の外国製機器を排除するＦＣＣの最近の措置によって、米製造業に数十億ドルの投資がもたらされ、国内で数千人の新規雇用が生まれたと述べた。

在ワシントン中国大使館は「米国が国家安全保障の概念を過度に拡大解釈することに断固反対する」と表明。トランプ政権に対し「中国企業への中傷や制裁による威嚇をやめるよう求める」とし、「中国は引き続き、中国企業の合法的かつ正当な権益を断固として守るために必要な措置を講じる」とした。

＜中国が市場を支配＞

調査会社カウンターポイント・リサーチによると、中国は光トランシーバーの世界市場の３分の２を占める。イーオプトリンク（新易盛）や、米国防総省の中国軍関連企業リストに追加された中際旭創（ゾンジー・イノライト）などの中国企業が世界の供給を支配しており、米国の大手クラウド事業者などを顧客に抱える。

米国のコヒレントとルメンタムも競合する技術を手掛けるが、米シンクタンクのファウンデーション・フォー・アメリカン・イノベーションの報告書によると、中国企業からの供給を代替できるほどの生産能力はない。

関係者の１人によると、米企業側は、中国が報復としてリン化インジウムの輸出を禁止する可能性を指摘した。リン化インジウムは、米企業が光トランシーバーを自社生産するために必要な重要鉱物だ。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：中国のクリーン技術輸出、途上国の脱炭素化後押し　気候分野で存在感 アングル：「身体を持つＡＩ」、中国ロボット業界が巨額投資　米企業と競争激化 焦点：トヨタの中国合弁2社に再編機運、市場縮小と競争激化で転換点 アングル：フォードの中国企業提携巡る毀誉褒貶、米政権のちぐはぐ対応が鮮明に アングル：中国に集まる「テック巡礼者」、イノベーション競争過熱で現場視察ブーム 11/18(水) 3:48 最終更新 ロイター

Investors slashed tech exposure allocations by most since 2006

FAST

LONDON, Nov 17 : Investors turned more cautious on technology stocks this month and sharply reduced their exposure to the sector as they anticipate slower capital spending, according to BofA's monthly fund manager survey.     Investors slashed their allocations to tech stocks by the most in a month since June 2006 according to the regular survey, which found investors are a net 12 per cent overweight tech, down from 37 per cent a month ago. Worries about a possible slowdown in spending on data centres after the US midterms caused tech stocks to tumble in recent weeks. The Nasdaq shed over 5 per cent in October and is down a further 3 per cent year to date.  BofA analysts said the "big message" from the investors they surveyed is for a pause or slowdown in AI capital expenditure.  Here are some of the other key findings from the report. •    A record 38 per cent of investors to the survey believe companies are over investing, and 52 per cent expect an AI hyperscaler to announce a cut in capex in the next six months. •    Investors' top 'tail risk' for markets is an AI bubble, second is an AI hyperscaler credit event. Concerns about inflation and a disorderly rise in bond yields have receded. •    Investors have also moved towards bonds, and are now the now least underweight bonds since November 2025. •    Investors are not concerned about the global economy. Just 3 per cent predict a recession and their cash holdings are at their lowest in three months. •    For 2027, 36 per cent of investors think international stocks will perform best, 24 per cent US stocks, and 17 per cent gold. 42 per cent said the Japanese yen would be the best performing currency. •    BofA surveyed 169 investors with $461 billion in assets under management.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 日米豪印首脳会合、中国念頭に協力分野を具体化 共同文書も発出
item.description:
Tamiyuki Kihara
[１７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Tamiyuki Kihara

[１７日 ロイター] - 日米豪印４カ国（ＱＵＡＤ）首脳会合が１７日、東南アジア諸国連合（ＡＳＥＡＮ）首脳会議に合わせてフィリピン・マニラで開かれた。４カ国はインド太平洋地域における中国の影響力拡大を念頭に、同地域での連携強化を盛り込んだ共同文書を発出する。

首脳会合の開催は約２年ぶりとなる。高市早苗首相、トランプ米大統領、アルバニージー豪首相、モディ印首相に加え、各国の政権幹部らが出席した。高市氏は会合の冒頭、ＱＵＡＤが地域の海洋安全保障、経済安全保障、エネルギーなどの分野で各国の自由な意思決定を支え、平和と安定に貢献するとの考えを示し、協力の枠組みをさらに発展させるよう呼びかけた。

日本外務省は今回の会合を「４カ国による戦略的認識を共有する機会」と位置付ける。政府関係者によると、安倍晋三元首相が提唱した「自由で開かれたインド太平洋」（ＦＯＩＰ）が１０年の節目を迎え、改めて法の支配に基づく地域の安定の重要性を確認する意向だ。４カ国は中国を念頭に、輸出規制や経済的な威圧への懸念を表明する見通し。地域に不安定化をもたらす一方的な行動に反対する姿勢も打ち出す。

具体的な協力分野としては、サイバーセキュリティーや海底ケーブルの強靭性向上、海洋監視などが挙がる。４カ国によるビジネスフォーラムを来年早期に開催するなど、安全保障、経済両面でさらなる関係強化を図りたい考えだ。

一方、１９日には米中ロ首脳会談が中国・深圳で開かれる予定だ。日本には同会談を前に、基本的価値を共有するＱＵＡＤの枠組みの重要性をトランプ氏に訴え、中ロを牽制する思惑もある。外務省関係者は「４カ国の強固な関係を世界に発信することが重要だ」と話す。

（鬼原民幸　編集：橋本浩）

item.description: Nov 17 : General Motors is aiming to increase use of robots and other automation by 20 per cent at its North American factories by 2028, two people familiar with the matter said, as the automaker grapples with higher labor and onshoring costs.The Detroit automaker is developing its own robots and assembling

Exclusive-GM plans 20% boost in robotics as factory costs rise

An assembly robot operates on the line at automaker General Motors (GM) Brightdrop unit's CAMI EV Assembly, Canada's first full-scale electric vehicle manufacturing plant, in Ingersoll, Ontario, Canada December 5, 2022. REUTERS/Carlos Osorio

FAST

Nov 17 : General Motors is aiming to increase use of robots and other automation by 20 per cent at its North American factories by 2028, two people familiar with the matter said, as the automaker grapples with higher labor and onshoring costs. The Detroit automaker is developing its own robots and assembling them at its Kokomo, Indiana, plant, the same people and two other people said, and is focused on using autonomous mobile robots to move parts around its plants. The 20 per cent automation target and production of robots in Indiana have not previously been reported. Automation is likely to emerge as a key  issue in the United Auto Workers' next round of negotiations with GM, Ford Motor and Jeep parent Stellantis, before the contracts expire in spring 2028.

The UAW, which represents about 50,000 GM factory workers, criticized the company's automation efforts as a job-cutting tactic.  "Their idea of being more efficient is to cut the very people who create their product and profits," UAW Vice President Ryan Hiestand said in a statement to Reuters after publication of the initial story. "We don't need more robots so GM can do another stock buyback." GM did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Earlier, the company said it uses automation to improve safety, quality and efficiency. “As competition intensifies globally, we continue to put these technologies to work in ways that support our manufacturing teams,” it said. GM ASKING SUPPLIERS FOR MORE AUTOMATION As manufacturers expand the use of robots and AI in their factories to boost efficiency, they risk rankling labor groups that are guarding against job losses.  GM is still buying robotics equipment from outside suppliers while developing its own in-house, an effort that company executives outlined last year. It also is asking parts suppliers bidding on new contracts to submit automation plans for their own operations, two other people familiar with GM’s supply base said. GM is using a scorecard to rate suppliers' automation efforts and considering the scores in contract decisions, the people said.  US automakers have increased automation to contain manufacturing costs since the UAW won record contract gains from GM, Ford and Stellantis in 2023. President Donald Trump's drive to bring more factory work home also has put pressure on production costs.  GM said the 2023 contract would add about $575 in labor costs per vehicle; Ford pegged its added cost at $900 per vehicle. At the time, analysts said the companies likely would increase automation as a way to defray the higher labor costs. GM last year said it had about 100 roboticists, AI engineers and hardware specialists working on advanced robotics systems.  TENSIONS STIR OVER AUTOMATION US automakers have long said their labor costs exceed those of foreign rivals and newer competitors such as Tesla, whose US factories are largely nonunion. UAW President Shawn Fain already has warned that AI and increased automation pose a threat to workers. “The fruits of our labor have multiplied like never before, but workers aren't reaping the harvest. That's theft,” Fain said at a UAW convention in June. “And if AI continues to be used as an accessory to that crime, it has to be stopped.” During a February episode of the "Automated" podcast, Mikell Taylor, GM director of robotics strategy, said manufacturers need to design processes that take advantage of the respective strengths of workers and robots. “How do I get the best out of both the people here and the machines here to get as much efficiency and quality as I can?” she said. ‘LESS HOURS INTO PRODUCTION’ GM and other automakers have used robots in their factories for decades to weld together body panels, for example, or move supplies between stations. But they are exploring more ways to integrate robotics and AI into their plants to increase productivity, especially as they grapple with higher costs from rising commodity expenses and efforts to localize supply chains. “It's all about the end game: putting less hours into the production of the vehicle so (automakers) can be more efficient and more profitable,” said Laurie Harbour, a partner who specializes in automotive at Wipfli, a tax and advisory firm. She added that increased automation can ease labor shortages for auto manufacturers.

Source: Reuters

Analysis:Nvidia turmoil marks the end of easy money for the AI trade

The NVIDIA logo on the exterior of NVIDIA's Shanghai office building in Shanghai, China, November 10, 2026. REUTERS/Go Nakamura

17 Nov 2026 07:12PM (Updated: 17 Nov 2026 07:42PM)

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 17 : Tumult at Nvidia spells the end of easy money for the AI sector and a funding squeeze for smaller, highly leveraged "neocloud" companies that have helped fuel the industry's rapid expansion. In recent years, Nvidia's financial support has boosted infrastructure providers and other partners of the giant chip firm. Bond investors say the uncertainty over who might eventually succeed ousted Chief Executive Jensen Huang has raised questions about Nvidia's willingness to continue support through vendor financing, guarantees and other methods, hitting these firms' shares and bonds. "It's fair to say that anyone who takes over is going to have a lower risk threshold than Jensen when it comes to Nvidia's balance sheet," said Loren Moran, fixed income portfolio manager, at Wellington Management. "There may just be a lot less credit availability toward weaker players." Chief among the firms cast in an uncertain new light are the so-called neocloud firms such as CoreWeave and Nebius, cloud computing companies that acquire graphics processing units (GPUs) or electronic chips, renting out computing capacity to AI developers, startups, and large technology companies.

NEOCLOUD BONDS DROP Last week, credit investors resumed their retreat from bonds exposed to Nvidia-related risk. Bonds in CoreWeave issued in June at a yield of 9.625 per cent plunged in value, sending their yield to nearly 15 per cent. The company's shares have lost 45 per cent since the Nasdaq hit its latest record on October 6, even after the company said on its earnings conference call last week that it would be able to continue to finance its operations by doing things such as borrowing against its chips. Nvidia is a shareholder and buyer of last resort for CoreWeave's unsold cloud capacity through April 2032 under a $6.3 billion order. Convertible bonds of Nebius, issued at a 4.5 per cent yield in August, dropped to 70 US cents to the dollar last Friday, sending yields surging to more than 12 per cent. Nebius rents out the computing power that AI firms need to train and run their models. Nvidia said in March it would invest $2 billion in Nebius, representing an 8.3 per cent stake in the company. Nebius stock is down 57 per cent since October 6. Many of these neocloud companies operate with smaller balance sheets while relying heavily on external financing to fund the enormous costs associated with acquiring GPUs and building data centers. "Nvidia's contracts and existing guarantees should not change with Jensen Huang's departure," said Tony Trzcinka, investment-grade portfolio manager at Impax Asset Management. "It's all about whether Jensen's successor would want to be as adventurous in going into all these different arrangements." WIDENING DISPARITY For Nvidia itself, some investors argued that a more conservative approach to balance sheet risk could be credit-positive. Wellington's Moran said she was concerned about the company's huge financial commitments across the AI space and believes a reduced appetite for risk could "clip some of that tail." But a more cautious Nvidia could have different implications for the broader AI financing environment. It could, for instance, widen the disparity between investment-grade borrowers and lower-rated companies dependent on private credit, leveraged loans and high-yield debt markets. Companies relying on financing tied directly or indirectly to Nvidia may find future capital either harder to obtain or significantly more expensive, analysts said. Hyperscalers such as Alphabet and Microsoft appear best positioned to weather such a shift, investors say, given their strong balance sheets that can finance data center construction on their own. "Most of their AI spending comes from internal cash flow and debt markets," said Danny Zaid, portfolio manager at TwentyFour Asset Management, and that is "unlikely going to change in the near term with the strong AI momentum expected to continue." At the other end of the spectrum, investors have already been demanding greater compensation to finance data center projects from lower-rated AI borrowers. "In a construction phase (of a project) where there is a high-yield name, you're going to have a materially higher cost of funding," said Trzcinka of Impax. In Goldman Sachs' "Top of Mind" research note, Miriam Wheeler, the bank's global head of leveraged finance, said the pace of AI deals in the high-yield market has significantly slowed in recent weeks amid investor concerns over mounting supply and political uncertainty. Wheeler said the market had expected roughly $60 billion of issuance this fall, which had pressured spreads. But supply has dried up since late September, "with no new deals over the past month." The slowdown suggests the easy financing conditions that have fueled AI-linked issuance are beginning to fade, analysts said. "The uncertainty for the overall space means greater risk premiums expected by investors," said Zaid of TwentyFour Asset Management. "Expect dispersion to increase as investors evaluate credits on a case-by-case basis."

Source: Reuters

FAST

BRUSSELS, Nov 17 : The European Union tech regulator charged Chinese e-commerce giant Temu on Tuesday for not doing enough to stop the sale of illegal products on its platform in breach of online content rules, putting it at risk of a second hefty fine. The European Commission, which acts as the tech regulator for the 27-country bloc, said Temu's mitigation measures "include ineffective controls to check the compliance of products; a weak content moderation system; and an ineffective sanction system". A spokesperson for Temu said the company disagreed with the Commission's preliminary findings and that the company makes significant efforts to mitigate illegal product risk. The e-commerce giant will respond to the Commission, he said. "We are confident that we will reach an amicable resolution of the matter that fully addresses the Commission's remaining concerns," the spokesperson said.

The Commission said that Temu, which is owned by PDD Holdings, has the possibility to exercise its rights to defence and reply to its preliminary findings. If the Commission's findings were ultimately confirmed, it would adopt a "non-compliance decision", which would trigger a fine of up to 6 per cent of the company's annual worldwide turnover. Such a fine would be the second imposed on Temu, after a €200 million ($220.12 million) penalty in May in the first part of an investigation opened two years ago under the Digital Services Act that requires large online companies to do more to tackle illegal and harmful content on their platforms. The earlier fine was for not assessing the risks of sales of illegal products, while Tuesday's charges were for not taking adequate measures to stop such sales. The Commission said last month it had accepted Temu's action plan to remedy the breach that had triggered the existing fine. Temu, along with Shein and other e-commerce platforms, has also been hit by the EU imposing €3 fees on low-value e-commerce packages since the start of July. Parcels worth less than €150 previously entered the bloc duty-free. ($1 = 0.9086 euros)

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米エヌビディア株、決算発表後に3350億ドルの時価総額変動も
item.description:
Laura Matthews
[ニューヨーク １７日 ロイター] - オプション市場は、米半導体大手エヌビディアが１...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米エヌビディア株、決算発表後に3350億ドルの時価総額変動も 11/17 20:09 配信

エヌビディアのロゴ、台北オフィスで11月12日撮影 REUTERS/Ann Wang（ロイター） Laura Matthews

[ニューヨーク １７日 ロイター] - オプション市場は、米半導体大手エヌビディアが１７日午後に第３・四半期決算を発表した後、約３３５０億ドルの時価総額変動を織り込んでいる。同社を巡る不確実性を示している。

ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の辞任以来、エヌビディアの株価は急落。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、時価総額は１０月初旬の約５兆８０００億ドルから今月１３日には約３兆９０００億ドルに減少。株価は１６日に４％下落した。

サスケハナによると、オプション市場は決算発表翌日の１８日に、株価がどちらの方向にも８．５％変動することを織り込んでおり、これは過去８四半期の決算発表後の平均変動率の２倍以上。前回の決算発表後の８．７４％の上昇率にわずかに及ばない。

サスケハナのデリバティブ戦略担当共同責任者クリス・マーフィー氏は「今後３日間は決算発表が主な材料となるが、プライシングには決算だけでなく、企業の新たな動向やトランプ米大統領の発言といった継続的なヘッドラインリスクも織り込まれている」と述べた。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：ＡＩ投資に迫られる「総点検」、見えないリスクの把握急務に 焦点：「ＡＩの銀行」エヌビディア、ブームへ資金供給後退なら深刻な事態に 焦点：バイナンス63億ドル被害、ハッカー対策で問われる交換所の内部統制 焦点：最高値圏に戻した米株、投機ポジションやオプション取引は一段高示唆 アングル：円は安値圏の攻防か、変動なきオプション市場　強まる介入警戒 11/17(火) 20:09 最終更新 ロイター

Shaky semiconductor trade faces big week, as investors look for bottom

FILE PHOTO: Semiconductor chips are seen on a printed circuit board in this illustration picture taken February 17, 2023. REUTERS/Florence Lo/Illustration/File Photo

NVIDIA logo and decreasing stock graph are seen in this illustration taken on November 16, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 17 : US semiconductor shares face a pivotal week, with key events set to test whether the once-high-flying group can regain its market luster. Semiconductor shares are at the heart of the AI trade, with voracious demand for chips propelling many of the companies' profits and share prices higher in 2026. But after soaring earlier in the year, the stocks have slid sharply in recent weeks due to growing doubts about the sustainability of AI investment spending. The latest anxiety-producing event was last week's abrupt resignation of Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia, the leading AI chipmaker, whose market value peaked at almost $6 trillion in early October but has since tumbled more than 30 per cent. Nvidia reports results after the US market closes on Tuesday. Two days later, trading is expected to begin for Claude chatbot creator Anthropic. Post-IPO trading could be a good barometer of AI sentiment, though analysts expect strong demand.

Chipmaker shares came under renewed pressure to start the week, with the Philadelphia SE Semiconductor index dropping over 5 per cent on the day. "You've got two big news events, and how the stocks behave in the face of those events is going to kind of give you an indication whether they are bottoming or that there's further downside," said Chuck Carlson, CEO at Horizon Investment Services. CHIPS STILL UP ON YEAR In the wake of Huang's departure, Nvidia, whose advanced chips put it at the center of the AI boom, will be under scrutiny not just for its results but for its commentary from its new leadership. Nvidia is "the standard bearer for the industry," said Walter Todd, chief investment officer at Greenwood Capital. "Almost by definition, they are going to set the tone for either stopping this downdraft that we've seen or perpetuating it." The Philadelphia semiconductor index more than doubled this year through late June, but since then the index has tumbled 34 per cent. It is still up over 35 per cent in 2026, far outpacing the S&P 500's 8.3 per cent year-to-date gain. Many of the stocks have posted severe declines since the Nasdaq Composite's all-time high on October 6. Nvidia is down nearly 35 per cent in that time, while Intel slumped over 50 per cent and Micron Technology dropped 31 per cent. EARNINGS GROWTH TO MODERATE, BY HOW MUCH? Investors have sold AI-related shares due to mounting questions about whether investment spending will translate to outsized returns. Those concerns flared after Democrats' sweeping victory this month in midterm elections, which industry analysts believe augurs more stringent regulations on the expansion of AI data centers. Earnings for the S&P 500 semiconductor and semi equipment group, which includes 20 companies, are expected to rise overall by about 125 per cent in 2026, according to Tajinder Dhillon, head of earnings and equity research at LSEG. In 2027, earnings are expected to rise by about 65 per cent. However, doubts about chipmakers' earnings prospects have pressured the stocks and their valuations. The S&P 500 semiconductor group's forward price-to-earnings ratio, based on earnings for the next 12 months, is around its lowest level in at least six years, according to LSEG Datastream. The 2027 "debate is shifting from can AI spending sustain its current trajectory, to how much slowdown is already priced in?" semiconductor analysts at BofA Global Research said in a note on Monday. The BofA analysts said they believe the SOX index is within 10 per cent to 15 per cent of a potential trough based on prior cycles. READING THE NVIDIA TEA LEAVES Whether such a bottom is near could rest on signals from Nvidia's report. Huang has been a driving force behind Nvidia's financing of various deals in the AI ecosystem, and the extent to which interim CEO Colette Kress backs Huang's strategy could reverberate broadly. Nvidia's view about how the elections will affect the data-center buildout will also be important, Carlson said. Capital spending by AI hyperscalers is expected to reach $1.3 trillion next year, according to Barclays analysts. "This is the company that the whole AI trade orbits around," Carlson said. "So people want to know their thinking on what they're seeing over the next 12 months to 18 months." Anthropic's IPO also could cause more volatility. The stock is expected to start trading on Nasdaq on Thursday. "How it trades after that will be impactful to the broader tech space, and certainly to chips," Todd said. "If it quickly trades below the IPO price, that I would expect would put further downward pressure on the whole AI ecosystem."

Source: Reuters

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 17 : Options traders are pricing in a roughly $335 billion swing in Nvidia's market value after the company reports third-quarter earnings on Tuesday afternoon, the latest sign of the uncertainty clouding the giant chip firm's outlook. Nvidia shares have tumbled since CEO Jensen Huang resigned last week following reports he had affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and with a subordinate at Nvidia. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress is serving as interim CEO as the company searches for a permanent successor. The selloff has reduced the chip maker's market value to about $3.9 trillion on Friday from about $5.8 trillion in early October, according to LSEG data. Shares were down 4 per cent on Monday. Options traders were pricing in a 8.5 per cent move in either direction on Wednesday, a day after the company reports results, more than twice the stock's average post-earnings move over the past eight quarters and just shy of the 8.74 per cent gain following its previous report, according to Susquehanna.

The implied move exceeds the individual market value of about 90 per cent of S&P 500 constituents.  Investors have been trimming Nvidia stock holdings ahead of earnings while continuing to buy call options and call spreads to participate in a potential rebound, said Chris Murphy, co-head of derivatives strategy at Susquehanna. A call option gives holders the right, but not the obligation, to buy the stock at certain price before the contract expires; a call spread involves buying a call option and selling another call option at a different price but with the same expiration.  "Earnings are the main catalyst over the next three days, but that pricing also captures ongoing headline risk — including new company developments and Trump comments — rather than earnings alone," Murphy said. US President Donald Trump said he would not oppose Huang's return as Nvidia CEO, while a petition calling for his return gathered more than 178,000 signatures, including from prominent Silicon Valley executives. Nvidia's board is not weighing a return for Jensen Huang as CEO, three people told Reuters. Nvidia shares are down nearly 17 per cent this year. The S&P 500 is up 8 per cent year-to-date and the Philadelphia SE Semiconductor index has risen 36 per cent. Sentiment toward chip makers and the AI infrastructure buildout has turned negative, reflecting rising borrowing costs and concerns that growth in the sector could slow after Democrats swept the midterm elections. Investors are focused on whether Nvidia can reassure the market that demand for AI infrastructure remains strong despite all these recent developments.  "(It) will be forward-looking statements about the order book, customers possibly canceling and pushing out, whether data center regulatory issues mean that data centers are going to take longer than we thought," said Chris Grisanti, chief market strategist at MAI Capital Management. "There's less here than meets the eye, in the sense of data center growth will continue in ‘27. Nvidia is the monopoly provider of chips, and it's not hard to connect the dots to a higher stock price with those two things."

Source: Reuters

item.title: 英、若者の不就労対策に「システム全面再構築」必要＝政府報告書
item.description:
David Milliken
[ロンドン １６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
David Milliken

[ロンドン １６日 ロイター] - 英国は欧州で最高水準にある若年層の不就労率を引き下げるため、若者向けの福祉給付と就労支援を巡る「システムの全面的な再構築」を必要としている。１７日に全文が公表される政府報告書に先立ち、与党・労働党の元閣僚であるアラン・ミルバーン氏が明らかにした。

同氏は、２５歳未満の若者に対する給付額の引き下げや、長期失業状態にある若者に対する強制的な就労体験の拡大を提案する。ただ、大幅な改善が見られるまでには１０年を要すると警告した。

若年層の失業は長年にわたり英国の根深い問題となっているが、労働党は、社会保障保険料の引き上げ、最低賃金の引き上げ、新規採用者の解雇を困難にする雇用法によって、この問題をさらに悪化させていると野党から非難されてきた。

また、健康上の理由で給付金を請求する若者の増加も、英国で急増している福祉支出の中で最も議論の的となっている要素の一つだ。

バーナム首相はミルバーン氏の計画を支持する必要性を訴えているが、支援削減案は与党内の左派議員の反発を招く恐れがある一方、野党側はこの計画では不十分と主張するとみられる。

ミルバーン氏は「福祉ではなく、仕事を次世代の未来とする新たな枠組みを構築する時だ」と訴えた。

英国では、今年第２・四半期時点で、１６─２４歳のうち就労・就学・職業訓練のいずれにも従事していない「ニート」が９８万１０００人に上り、同年齢層の８人に１人を占めており、この割合は昨年、欧州で２番目に高かった。

若年層の失業率も１５．１％と、４％未満の年長労働者の失業率に比べて異例の高さとなっている。

item.title: Estonia's plan to shut Russian border disrupts families on both sides
item.description: As soon as Estonia announced it was shutting its land border with Russia next month, Alla Guseva decided she had to bring her 86-year-old mother home to St Petersburg.
item.content:encoded:
Estonia's plan to shut Russian border disrupts families on both sides As soon as Estonia announced it was shutting its land border with Russia next month, Alla Guseva decided she had to bring her 86-year-old mother home to St Petersburg. Reuters | Updated: 18-11-2026 00:28 IST | Created: 18-11-2026 00:28 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

As soon as Estonia announced it was shutting its land border with Russia next month, Alla Guseva decided she had to bring her 86-year-old mother home to St Petersburg. Her mother had been living on her own in Estonia's capital Tallinn, but with the border shutting it was now too much of a risk to leave her there. "I cannot leave her alone," Guseva told Reuters as she and her mother stood for hours in the queue to exit on the Estonian side, bundled against the cold. Estonia, which along with Baltic neighbours Latvia and Lithuania are the only EU countries that still operate overland border crossings with Russia, announced on Sunday it would close its three crossings from December. It said the measure was necessary after blaming Russia's GRU military intelligence service for ordering an attempted arson attack on drone maker Threod Systems. Eight Latvian residents suspected of carrying it out were arrested. "Russia must understand that hostile actions against Estonia come with consequences," Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna said on X. The Kremlin said on Monday it "completely rejects" that Russia was behind the attempted arson, and accused Estonia of "building a wall" by closing the border. FAMILIES ON BOTH SIDES Thousands of people living in Estonia have family in Russia or vice versa, as legacies of the Soviet era. The crossing at Narva, a majority Russian-speaking city on the Estonian side of the border, is also used by people travelling from further afield in Europe to reach St Petersburg a few hours' drive away. Marina Kupchenko, a Russian pensioner living in France, said she regularly travels via Tallinn and Narva to visit her elderly mother in St Petersburg, but the trip, by air over third countries, will now be far more difficult and expensive. "The closure will have a very serious effect on me," she said. "My mother cannot move out, so I must keep visiting her. I am her only daughter." Andrey Kukkonen, 56, from Finland, said he was visiting his wife's mother living in Russia. Since Finland shut down its own Russian border in 2023, the trip now takes him 24 hours. It will take three days if Estonia closes its border, he said. "This is politics and it's leading nowhere. The only outcome is people who have relations across the border will start to cut them. Why?" Of the 760,000 people who crossed the Estonia-Russia border this year, 307,000 were Russian nationals, 175,000 were Estonian citizens and 54,000 held Finnish passports, Estonian police data showed. Katri Riik, a former mayor of Narva, said local businesses will take a hit from the lack of visitors, further depressing the economy in a remote corner of the EU. "People in Narva do not understand why this measure is needed, especially ahead of Christmas and New Year," she said. "We used to pride ourselves on being the gateway to Europe. Now we are becoming its fringe." (Writing by Andrius Sytas Editing by Peter Graff)

(This story has not been edited by Devdiscourse staff and is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

item.title: 米当局、違法電子たばこ工場を摘発 中国メーカーが生産移転か
item.description:
Emma Rumney
[ロンドン １７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Emma Rumney

[ロンドン １７日 ロイター] - 米当局が１０月、違法な電子たばこを製造する工場を摘発していたことが、警察の説明などで明らかになった。輸入品の取り締まり強化を受け、中国メーカーが生産の一部を米国に移したことを示している。

中国資本の使い捨て電子たばこブランドは、合法的な販売に必要な米食品医薬品局（ＦＤＡ）の認可を得ていないにもかかわらず、米国市場を席巻している。

カリフォルニア州オンタリオの警察報道官によると、当局は１０月３０日、ロサンゼルス東方のチノにある倉庫群の一部を捜索した。「ギークバー」や「フォガー」などの人気ブランドを含む電子たばこや部品など約８５万点が見つかった。包装資材のほか、ブランド表示を施したり、製品を収縮フィルムで包装したりする機械も発見したという。

報道官は、現場で見つかった設備から、電子たばこの違法製造に使われていたとみられると説明した。

＜戦略を転換する中国の電子たばこメーカー＞

ＦＤＡは中国資本の電子たばこに販売認可を与えておらず、輸入や販売は違法だとしている。

一部の中国企業は、製品に「メード・イン・ＵＳＡ」と表示するなど、新たな戦略で対応している。

捜査関係者によると、これまで完成品の輸入に頼ってきた中国の主要ブランドが生産の一部を米国に移し始めたことを裏付ける証拠が見つかったのは、１０月の捜索が初めてだという。

オンタリオ警察の報道官によると、捜索時に現場にいた作業員は、工場が２０２６年に稼働を始めたと当局に話した。現場には正規品と偽造品の両方があったとみられるという。

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
独ＺＥＷ景気期待指数、11月35.6に上昇　予想上回る 11/17 19:49 配信

フランクフルトのドイツ銀行本店、2019年撮影 REUTERS/Kai Pfaffenbach（ロイター） [ベルリン １７日 ロイター] - 欧州経済研究センター（ＺＥＷ）が１７日発表した１１月のドイツ景気期待指数は３５．６と、前月の２８．１から市場予想以上に上昇した。

ロイターがまとめたアナリスト予想は２８．３だった。

ＺＥＷのアヒム・ワムバッハ所長は「ドイツ経済は緩やかながらも回復軌道を維持している」と述べ、製造業受注の増加と原油価格の下落が回復を支えるとの見方を示した。

ドイツの現況指数はマイナス３３．２と、前月のマイナス３５．９から上昇した。

ワムバッハ氏は、これまでの回復を主に支えてきたのは政府支出だと指摘。「ただ、これにより公的債務の持続可能性への懸念が高まっている」と述べた。

item.description: 米規制がアジアＡＩ産業直撃、データセンターなどサービス企業の対応必須 Reuters

item.title: 米規制がアジアＡＩ産業直撃、データセンターなどサービス企業の対応必須
item.description:
Rozanna Latiff Xinghui Kok
[シンガポール １７日 ロイター] - 東南アジアのデータセンタ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米規制がアジアＡＩ産業直撃、データセンターなどサービス企業の対応必須 11/17 19:46 配信

マレーシアのデータセンター建設現場、5月7日撮影 REUTERS/Hasnoor Hussain/File Photo（ロイター） Rozanna Latiff　Xinghui Kok

[シンガポール １７日 ロイター] - 東南アジアのデータセンター・半導体サプライチェーン（供給網）関連企業の株価が１７日、急落した。米政府が人工知能（ＡＩ）向け先端半導体の輸出規制強化を発表したことを嫌気した。

新規則は、マレーシア、シンガポール、タイなど域内主要国への先端半導体の出荷を制限する。一部の中国企業はこれらの国を通じて、ＡＩモデルの学習に必要な計算能力を利用してきた。また、中国に本社を置く企業に「大量の計算能力」を提供する海外データセンターにも新たな要件を課す。

調査会社カウンターポイントのバイスプレジデント、ニール・シャー氏は「中国のＡＩ開発企業は、海外データセンターから米国の先端技術による計算能力を借りることで、ハードウエアの禁輸措置を回避することができなくなる」と指摘。「規制対応の負担は、ハードウエアメーカーからクラウドサービス事業者や企業へと根本的に移った」と指摘。域内のデータセンター企業は今後、顧客確認で膨大な対応を求められるとした。

マレーシアでは、データセンターインフラ企業のＭＮホールディングスとクリティカル・ホールディングスがともに２０％近く急落。ＡＩインフラでエヌビディアと提携するＹＴＬパワーは１０％近く下落した。

サクソのシンガポール在勤チーフ投資ストラテジスト、チャル・チャナナ氏は「中国の顧客に依存する海外データセンター運営企業にとっては、稼働率の低下や価格下落圧力、拡張の遅れにつながる可能性がある。一方、中国のＡＩ開発企業はコスト上昇や開発の遅れに直面しかねない」と述べた。

シンガポールでは、オランダの半導体製造装置大手ＡＳＭＬに供給するフレンケンが３．９１％、インテルと取引のある半導体検査会社ＡＥＭは２．９％それぞれ下落した。

売りは、中国、韓国、日本、台湾のデータセンター資材メーカーのほか、プリント基板、放熱、エネルギー関連銘柄にも広がった。

中国のハイテク株も下落し、アリババは５％、騰訊控股（テンセント）は３％それぞれ値下がりした。一方、中国最大の半導体受託製造会社で、中国政府が進める国産代替品への移行で重要な役割を担う中芯国際集成電路製造（ＳＭＩＣ）は７％上昇した。

シャー氏は「遠隔で計算能力を利用できなくなれば、中国のハイテク大手は短期的に深刻な計算能力の不足に直面する。ただ、長期的にはデカップリングを大きく促す要因になる」と見通しす。

その上で「米政府は国内の資本と技術者を、垂直統合型の自国製代替品に注力させ、エコシステムの構築を加速させている」 と語った。

＜「容認できない」転用リスク＞

新規則は、シンガポール、タイ、マレーシア、インドネシア、ブラジルを、先端半導体が転用される「容認できないリスク」がある国に指定した。これらの国に規制対象の半導体を出荷するには、米国の輸出許可が必要になる。

新規則は、エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が、中国のスパイと疑われる女性との不倫関係を報じられて辞任した数日後に公表された。女性はシンガポールのクラウド企業メガスピードに勤務していた。同社はエヌビディアの提携先で、データセンターの計算能力を貸し出しており、先端ＡＩ半導体を中国に違法に横流しした可能性を巡って調査の対象となっている。

先週、フアン氏とメガスピード幹部との関係をきっかけに東南アジアのデータセンター・半導体産業に注目が集まり、両業界は監視の強化に備えていた。

＜経済のけん引役＞

東南アジアは、世界でも特に成長の速いデータセンター市場の一つとなっている。世界のハイテク企業がＡＩ処理能力の増強を競う中、数百億ドル規模の投資を呼び込んでいる。

マレーシア投資貿易産業省によると、同国は２１年以降、データセンター関連で３８５７億リンギ（９５０億ドル）の投資を承認した。タイには２月時点で４２カ所のデータセンターがあり、ＩＴ機器の電力負荷は計３４００メガワット、投資額は約７５００億バーツ（２２６億ドル）に上る。

インドネシアの２５年のデータセンター市場規模は２８億１０００万ドルだった。

ＡＩブームは地域の経済成長への寄与を強めている。シンガポールは８月、ＡＩブームを理由に２６年の経済成長率予測を２．０─４．０％から４．５─５．５％に引き上げた。マレーシアでは、データセンター開発案件の増加で、２６年第３・四半期の建設部門が６％成長した。

シンガポールは２５年２月、エヌビディアの半導体売上高の２２％がシンガポールで事業を展開する企業向けとして計上されている一方、実際に同国に出荷されたのは１％にとどまると説明した。

シンガポールには近年、多くの中国企業が事務所を構えている。米中対立によるリスクを減らすため、貿易に重きを置くシンガポールに本拠を移す、いわゆる「シンガポール・ウォッシュ」の動きだ。

シンガポール当局は１７日、米国の新措置の詳細を慎重に精査していると明らかにした。影響を受ける企業とは事業への影響について協議しているという。措置の範囲や運用を巡り、米関係当局とも連絡を取っているとした。

貿易省と通信省は共同発表で、シンガポール国際的な評判を重視しており、シンガポールとの関係を利用して国際事業で輸出規制などの他国の法律を回避したり違反する企業を容認しないと表明した。

item.title: ホルムズ海峡でタンカーに2度目の攻撃、乗組員の安否不明
item.description: [１７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１７日 ロイター] - 英国海運貿易オペレーション（ＵＫＭＴＯ）は１７日、ホルムズ海峡を通航中のタンカーがオマーンの港湾都市ハサブの北方で２度目の攻撃を受け、乗組員の安否が不明になっていると発表した。

海上警備機関の情報として、２度目の攻撃はハサブの北１３キロメートルの地点で起き、船内で火災が発生したと説明した。被害の程度は分かっていないという。

ＵＫＭＴＯは当初、１６日の最初の攻撃でタンカーの機関室から出火し、航行不能になったものの、乗組員は無事だと報告していた。

item.description:
Jan Strupczewski
[ブリュッセル １７日 ロイター] - 欧州委員会は１７日、外需に支えられ、ユーロ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ユーロ圏、今年1.2％成長へ見通し上げ　仏は低成長に＝欧州委 11/17 19:35 配信

フランクフルトの金融街、2024年撮影 REUTERS/Kai Pfaffenbach（ロイター） Jan Strupczewski

[ブリュッセル １７日 ロイター] - 欧州委員会は１７日、外需に支えられ、ユーロ圏の今年の経済成長率が２０２５年と同じ１．２％になるとし、５月時点の予測（０．９％）から上方修正した。

２７年の成長率も１．２％となり、２８年には１．３％へと加速する見通しだ。しかし、ユーロ圏で２番目に大きな経済規模を持つフランスについては、今年の成長率はわずか０．４％、２７年は０．６％にとどまり、ユーロ圏全体で最も低い成長率になる見込み。

ユーロ圏のインフレ率は、２５年の２．１％から今年は３．２％に跳ね上がり、２７年には３．１％までしか低下せず、２８年に再び２．１％へと減速する見通し。

ユーロ圏全体の財政赤字は、２５年のＧＤＰ（総生産）比３．０％から２６年には３．５％に上昇し、２７年には３．６％、２８年には３．８％へとさらに上昇する見込み。

２９年までに赤字を欧州連合（ＥＵ）の上限である３．０％未満に削減することになっているフランスについては、政策が変更されない限り、２５年の５．１％に対し、今年は５．５％となり、２７年には５．４％にわずかに低下するものの、２８年には再び５．７％に上昇すると予測している。

欧州委は、ユーロ圏の公的債務は引き続き増加するとし、対ＧＤＰ比率は２５年の８８．６％から今年は８９．６％となり、２７年には９０．５％、２８年には９１．３％に上昇すると予測した。

フランスの債務はさらに急速に増加し、２５年の１１５．７％から今年は１１９．２％に、来年は１２２．１％、２８年には１２３．２％に達する見通し。

item.description:
(見出しの表現を一部変更しました)
［東京 １７日 ロイター］ - ネット証券大手の楽天証券は１７日、不正アクセス...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
再送-楽天証に不正アクセス、顧客情報漏えいの可能性　年収・資産情報も対象 11/17 19:32 配信

(見出しの表現を一部変更しました)

［東京　１７日　ロイター］ - ネット証券大手の楽天証券は１７日、不正アクセスにより顧客情報の一部が漏えいした可能性があることを確認したと発表した。顧客コード、ログインＩＤが最大約１１２５万口座、これらに氏名、勤務先や出金先口座、年収・金融資産などを加えた情報は最大約４４７万口座。

ログインに必要なパスワード、暗証番号など楽天証券の取引に必要な各種情報の漏えいは確認されておらず、現時点で今回の件に起因すると考えられる不正アクセスや不正取引は確認されていないという。

１６日に一部システムに不正アクセスの可能性を検知し、アクセスの遮断などを実行。調査の結果、１１日にテスト環境のシステム内で管理していた一部情報が漏えいした恐れがあることを確認したとしている。不正アクセスの原因や詳細な経緯は引き続き調査している。

FAST

Nov 17 : Artificial intelligence is accelerating the pace and scale of cyberattacks, leading to more incidents reported by businesses and creating new challenges for companies and their insurers, data from insurance broker Marsh showed. "The signs that the attackers are using AI enabled and agentic tools to identify vulnerabilities is happening. So I would say we could attribute AI to a significant number of these," Meredith Schnur, Marsh Risk's US and Canada cyber practice leader, told Reuters in an interview this week. • Marsh said its clients reported 105 cyber incidents in the last two weeks of October, more than double the 48 recorded in the final two weeks of May • AI is enabling attackers to identify and exploit longstanding vulnerabilities, including unpatched software, exposed systems and weak identity controls, at a much faster pace

• Schnur said the speed and scale of AI tool adoption, coupled with organizations taking longer to contain attacks and respond to incidents, were the main factors driving the recent increase in cyber incident volumes • "AI is not a peril, its an amplification of risk in all areas," Schnur said • As AI tools become more widely accessible, attackers can scale their operations with fewer resources, widening the pool of potential targets and putting pressure on businesses • According to GlobalData, cyber insurance premiums are set to grow at a faster pace over the next two years across the world as businesses respond to rising attack frequency • It expects global cyber insurance premiums to rise 6.9 per cent to $16.6 billion in 2026, before accelerating to 10 per cent growth in 2027 to reach $18.3 billion

Source: Reuters

item.title: Martin Cobb’s Top Picks for Nov. 17, 2026
item.description: As judged by the S&P 500 index level, the U.S. market was down in October. But the average stock therein was up. Indeed, the S&P 500 equal weighted index returned almost five per cent over the month, ...
item.content:encoded:
Martin Cobb, Senior Vice-President, Equities, Lorne Steinberg Wealth Management Focus: U.S. & Canadian Equities

Top Picks: WSP Global , PepsiCo , Alphabet MARKET OUTLOOK: Demand and supply. In any marketplace, price is set by the interaction of these two forces. A stock market is no different. Putting aside the competition from higher yielding bonds today, there has been a marked shift within the equity market itself. The third quarter saw yet another quite remarkable growth in earnings per share for the S&P 500, with something in the region of 30 per cent underlying progression versus the same period 12 months ago. But, despite that, the free cash flow generated from these same entities actually contracted year over year. For the better part of a decade, the stock market has been, in effect, a cannibal, using massive free cash flow to shrink the supply of public equity. Today, that equation is flipping in real time. Not only are we witnessing record initial public offerings (IPOs) but the very companies that were once reliable buyers of their own shares and now issuing them in size. While a US$75 trillion market can undoubtedly absorb this, the several hundred billion dollars in fresh supply compares with typically less than US$50 billion in any one year. What was once a reliable tailwind has shifted into a notable headwind. As judged by the S&P 500 index level, the U.S. market was down in October. But the average stock therein was up. Indeed, the S&P 500 equal weighted index returned almost five per cent over the month, the widest margin of monthly outperformance versus its market cap weighted peer since 2009. November is proving similar. How to set BNN Bloomberg as your preferred source on Google Market-moving news, fast:  Get the BNN Bloomberg App now Sign up for the Market Call Top Picks newsletter at  bnnbloomberg.ca/newsletters TOP PICKS: Martin Cobb’s Top Picks: WSP Global, PepsiCo & Alphabet Martin Cobb, senior vice-president in equities at Lorne Steinberg Wealth Management, iA Private Wealth, shares his top stock picks to watch in the market.

WSP Global (WSP TSX) A Canada to the world success story that today is a leading global professional services firm providing engineering, design, and strategic advisory services. Operate as a pure play consulting entity (i.e. take no construction risk) across a variety of sectors (such as transportation, infrastructure, property, utilities etc.) and with a particular strength in power & energy. Grown significantly through merge and acquisitions (M&A), with mid-teens average annual sales growth and profits compounding at an even higher rate Supposedly artificial intelligence (AI) is going to do away with the need for all sorts of consulting or certification businesses, including those that are, by nature, very manual in their process As a result, the stock’s valuation has collapsed: having historically commanded a mid 20s forward earning multiple during this past decade, today it sits on about 14 times 2027 And with the prospect of continued double-digit eps growt PepsiCo (PEP NASDAQ) Now more of a foods / snacks business than it is beverages Drinks brands include the eponymous one, Gatorade, Mountain Dew, Lipton, and various waters (incl Bubly) The food side’s key brands are Lays, Doritos and Cheetos Unlike Coca-Cola (which sells syrup) PepsiCo is fully vertically integrated and indeed views the ability to distribute to the same customer as a key competitive advantage Not a huge top line grower: maybe two to three per cent organic growth (but reasonably consistent) With a little bit of ongoing margin accretion, combined with ongoing portfolio activity, eps growth should at least reach mid single digits Pays out most of FCF in dividends (yield today just over four per cent) and has grown its payout consistently for 54 years now, i.e. a true dividend aristocrat Nothing really has changed in recent years other than a sustained compression in the multiple investors have been willing to pay (historically 20 times plus was the norm) Now commanding a 17 times forward earnings multiple: that seems on the low side (Coke is on 28 times just for comparison Alphabet (GOOGL NASDAQ) Best known as the parent of Google, Alphabet is an advertising juggernaut with strong positions in search (Google), video (YouTube), and mobile (Android), with 90 per cent plus share in global online search Core advertising business still growing solidly despite admittedly facing challenges Firmly the third player globally in cloud behind AWS and Azure, but growing faster and with a strong upwards drive in profitability (Google Cloud’s margins are close to half of that of the other two) YouTube (which they paid less than $2 billion for in 2006) now has revenues above those of Netflix Massive optionality in “Other Bets” including driverless cars (Waymo), quantum computing, medical tech, AR/VR, machine learning etc. Large language models pose possibly the first ever real threat to Google’s search business. But must be put into context: perhaps 20 per cent of group revenues is at risk and Alphabet is not exactly sitting idle Over $100 billion in net cash and generating about twice that today in annual operating cashflow Admittedly spending a lot and decided on an opportunistic capital raising (not terribly enthused by that but at least it was at a share price north of $350) Share price has retraced markedly in recent months, with the stock trading at or below 20 times and 16 times anticipated earnings for 2027 and 2028 respectively DISCLOSURE PERSONAL FAMILY PORTFOLIO/FUND WSP TSX Y Y Y PEP NASD Y Y Y GOOGL NASD Y Y Y PAST PICKS: NOV. 26, 2025 Martin Cobb’s Past Picks: Kenvue, Starbucks & Canadian National Railway Martin Cobb, senior vice-president in equities at Lorne Steinberg Wealth Management, iA Private Wealth, discusses his past stock picks and how they’re doing.

item.content:encoded:
良品計画、紙製カードの株主優待「復活」　セキュリティー対策で 11/17 18:41 配信

上海の展示会の無印良品のブースで11月5日撮影。REUTERS/Go Nakamura（ロイター） Shinichi Uchida

［東京　１７日　ロイター］ - 良品計画は１７日、現在進めているシステム面の安全性確認や情報セキュリティー対策強化の対応に伴い、商品価格を割引する株主優待の提供方法を変更すると発表した。電子クーポンを中止し、紙製のカードによる提供とする。２６年８月末基準の優待を対象とする。

当初は電子クーポン方式を予定していたが、「安全性を十分に確保した上でサービスを提供することが困難」と判断した。なお、今回の対応は一時的な措置で、安全性の確認などを前提に次回以降は電子クーポンの提供を予定しているという。

同社は２６年２月末基準の株主優待から電子クーポン方式に移行した。それまでは紙製カードを株主に進呈し、有人レジで確認していた。

item.title: Bangladesh court grants 7-day remand of former Dhaka mayor Saeed Khokon
item.description: A Dhaka court on Tuesday granted a seven-day remand of former Dhaka South City Corporation (DSCC) Mayor and Awami League leader Mohammad Saeed Khokon in connection with a case linked to the killing of ...
item.content:encoded:
Bangladesh court grants 7-day remand of former Dhaka mayor Saeed Khokon  A Dhaka court on Tuesday granted a seven-day remand of former Dhaka South City Corporation (DSCC) Mayor and Awami League leader Mohammad Saeed Khokon in connection with a case linked to the killing of a man during the July 2024 uprising, amid mounting political tensions over former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's planned return to Bangladesh in December. ANI | Updated: 17-11-2026 23:09 IST | Created: 17-11-2026 23:09 IST

Representative Image (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

A Dhaka court on Tuesday granted a seven-day remand of former Dhaka South City Corporation (DSCC) Mayor and Awami League leader Mohammad Saeed Khokon in connection with a case linked to the killing of a man during the July 2024 uprising, amid mounting political tensions over former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's planned return to Bangladesh in December. Metropolitan Magistrate Mehedi Hasan passed the order after the Detective Branch (DB) of police sought 10 days of remand for questioning Khokon in connection with the killing of Abdul Motaleb during the July Uprising, according to local media reports. Khokon was detained by the Special Response Battalion (SRB) from his residence in Dhaka's Baridhara area at around 7 am on Tuesday and subsequently handed over to the detectives. He was later produced before the court by the DB. According to local media reports, State Prosecutor Omar Faruq Faruqi supported the police's request for remand, while senior lawyer Abu Sayeed Sagor sought bail for Khokon and cancellation of the remand order. Investigators have alleged that Khokon helped orchestrate the crackdown on protesters during the July 2024 uprising by directing members of the Chhatra League, Jubo League and other Awami League-affiliated organisations to attack demonstrators, while allegedly providing them with money and weapons. The remand petition also accused him of organising surprise party marches after the fall of the Awami League government and maintaining contact with senior party leaders who are currently in hiding. Investigators further alleged that Khokon had planned activities to destabilise the country. The case relates to the killing of Abdul Motaleb, who was shot dead during a procession near the Zigatola bus stand in Dhaka's Dhanmondi area on August 4, 2024. His father, Abdul Matin, filed the case at Dhanmondi Police Station on August 26, 2024, after the fall of the Awami League government. The case names 176 people, including then Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, former Home Minister Asaduzzaman Khan Kamal and former Road Transport Minister Obaidul Quader. Khokon's arrest comes amid mounting political tensions following Sheikh Hasina's announcement that she would return to Bangladesh in December. Leaders and activists of the Awami League and its affiliated organisations have reportedly become increasingly active in different parts of the country. Although the activities of the Awami League have been banned in Bangladesh, incidents of violence have continued to be reported in various areas, with the banned party being blamed for several such activities. Gopalganj, Sheikh Hasina's home district, has witnessed some of the significant incidents of violence. Amid the evolving political situation, police and other law enforcement agencies have intensified operations against Awami League leaders and activists. Khokon's arrest is part of these ongoing actions. Khokon, the son of former undivided Dhaka mayor Mohammad Hanif, became the Mayor of Dhaka South City Corporation in 2015. He later won the Dhaka-6 parliamentary constituency as an Awami League candidate in the 2024 parliamentary elections, according to local media reports. (ANI)

item.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝下落、米規制が圧迫 ネット企業など打撃
item.description: [香港 １７日 ロイター] - 中国・香港株式市場は下落して引けた。米国による中国への先端人工知能（ＡＩ）半導体規制強化...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝下落、米規制が圧迫　ネット企業など打撃 11/17 18:24 配信

[香港 １７日 ロイター] - 中国・香港株式市場は下落して引けた。米国による中国への先端人工知能（ＡＩ）半導体規制強化の影響を見極めようとするなか、中国株は数カ月ぶりの安値を付けた。アジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議も注目されている。

中国のＣＳＩ３００指数は０．１％安で引けた。取引時間中には２０２５年７月以来の安値を付けた。

上海総合指数は０．５％安の３５８４．５８で終了。一時１％下落し、２５年８月以来の安値となった。

深セン証券取引所の新興企業向け市場「創業板（チャイネクスト）」総合指数は上げから反転し１．２％安で引けた。上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」５０指数も上げ幅を縮め０．６％高。

ＣＳＩ半導体指数は３．２％上昇し、情報技術株指数は０．１％高となった。トランプ米政権が中国による米国製先端ＡＩ半導体の入手を一段と制限することが、中国国内企業の追い風になる可能性が期待された。

一方、中国のインターネット大手は下落した。先端半導体の入手制限がＡＩ事業の展開を妨げるとの懸念が重荷となった。アリババは約５％、百度（バイドゥ）は５．５％、それぞれ下落した。

これが香港市場全体を押し下げた。ハンセン指数は１％超安の２万３５０８．１７となり、ハンセンテック指数は１．１％下落した。

モルガン・スタンレーのアナリストはリポートで「同じセクター内でも銘柄間の差が一段と広がると予想する」と指摘。中国に対する技術規制の一段の強化は、国産化の恩恵を受ける銘柄への政策面と需要面の支援材料を強める一方、米国の許可を要するハードウエアや国外の計算処理能力に依存する中国本土外の上場銘柄にはリスクを高めるとした。

投資家は１１月１８─１９日に深センで開催されるＡＰＥＣ首脳会議にも注目している。

中国の習近平国家主席、トランプ米大統領、ロシアのプーチン大統領は３者会合を開き、通商政策やウクライナとイランでの戦争、核兵器、ＡＩなど世界的な懸案について協議する予定だ。

アジアの他の市場も米株安に追随して下落した。エヌビディアの決算発表を控え、米国の対中技術規制がセンチメントを圧迫した。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：「身体を持つＡＩ」、中国ロボット業界が巨額投資　米企業と競争激化 焦点：トヨタの中国合弁2社に再編機運、市場縮小と競争激化で転換点 アングル：フォードの中国企業提携巡る毀誉褒貶、米政権のちぐはぐ対応が鮮明に アングル：中国に集まる「テック巡礼者」、イノベーション競争過熱で現場視察ブーム 焦点：ＳＨＥＩＮの香港上場、ＥＳＧ問題がなお影　投資家の懸念根強く 11/17(火) 18:24 最終更新 ロイター

item.content:encoded:
Tiger Woods confirms competitive golf return for December at Bahamas This invite-only tournamrnt, hosted by Woods' Foundation has previously served as a comeback event for the golf icon, who has limited his playing time since injuries sustained during a car crash back in February 2021. ANI | Updated: 17-11-2026 22:51 IST | Created: 17-11-2026 22:51 IST

Tiger Woods (Photo: Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Golf legend Tiger Woods confirmed his return to competitive action during next month's Hero World Challenge, reported Sky Sports. This invite-only tournamrnt, hosted by Woods' Foundation has previously served as a comeback event for the golf icon, who has limited his playing time since injuries sustained during a car crash back in February 2021. Woods has not appeared on PGA Tour since he missed the cut way back in July 2024. The 15-time major titlist also missed the last season due to Achillies tendon rupture. The golf legend underwent back surgery last October and missed this year's season away, "stepping away" following a car crash in March after which he was charged with reckless driving. The 50-year-old is now scheduled to compete in Bahamas. The event will be held from December 3-6, with 2019 US Open champion Gary Woodland and Rickie Fowler among the other players included in the 20-man field. Woods was absent from the line-up which was initially last month, with Hideki Matsuyama returning as defending champion and Scottie Scheffler gunning for his third title in four years, while Players champion Cameron Young and former US Open winner Matt Fitzpatrick also feature. The multi-time PGA Tour champion currently is the 'unranked' in OWGR standings. The former world number one had made just four 72-hole tournament appearances in last six seasons and has not been in the world's top ten since January 2020. His last appearance at this competition came back in 2023 and had previously won the tournament in 2001, 2004, 2006, 2007 and 2011. (ANI)

ＭＵＦＧ、東大・松尾研発企業に金融支援　日本発ＡＩ育成へ 11/17 18:07 配信

MUFGのロゴ。1月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） Miho Uranaka

[東京 １７日 ロイター] - 三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループ（ＭＵＦＧ）は１７日、人工知能（ＡＩ）研究の松尾研究所（東京・文京）と、同研究所などが立ち上げたＡＩ開発企業のサードインテリジェンス（東京・千代田）と包括的パートナーシップを締結したと発表した。企業の成長段階に応じた資金調達や顧客紹介などの支援を通じてスタートアップを育成し、国内のＡＩ産業の強化につなげる狙いだ。

松尾研究所は、ＡＩ研究の第一人者とされる東京大学大学院工学系研究科の松尾豊教授が技術顧問を務める。サードインテリジェンスは、共通の基盤を持ちながら利用者ごとの学習やタスクに合わせて最適化される国産の「遍在型ＡＧＩ（汎用人工知能）」の研究開発を進めている。
